title: US and Denmark reach deal over Greenland after Trump annexation threats
english: The United States and Denmark have reached a security agreement regarding Greenland, ending a diplomatic standoff caused by President Trump’s past threats to seize the territory. Under the deal, the U.S. gains increased influence over Greenland’s defense and investments to block adversaries, while Denmark maintains the island's sovereignty. The agreement is set to be formalized at the UN General Assembly and still requires final approval from the Danish parliament.
amharic: አሜሪካ እና ዴንማርክ በግሪንላንድ ደህንነት ዙሪያ ስምምነት ላይ ደርሰዋል፣ ይህም ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ ግዛቱን በጉልበት ለመውሰድ የነበራቸውን ዛቻ ተከትሎ የተፈጠረውን ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ውጥረት ያረገበ ነው። በአዲሱ ስምምነት መሰረት አሜሪካ በግሪንላንድ የጸጥታ እና የኢንቨስትመንት ጉዳዮች ላይ ሰፊ ቁጥጥር የምታገኝ ሲሆን ዴንማርክም የግዛቷን ሉዓላዊነት ታረጋግጣለች። ስምምነቱ በተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት ጠቅላላ ጉባኤ ላይ ይፋ የሚደረግ ሲሆን በዴንማርክ ፓርላማም ማጽደቅ ይጠበቅበታል።
oromo: Ameerikaa fi Deenmaark dhimma nageenyaa Gireenlaandi irratti walii galtee irra ga’aniiru; kunis kanaan dura Pirezidaanti Traamp naannichaa humnaan fudhachuuf sodaachisaa turan irraa kan ka’e rakkoo dippiloomaasii uumame tasgabbeesseera. Walii galticha kanaan Ameerikaan nageenyaa fi invastimantii Gireenlaandi irratti to’annoo guddaa kan argattu yoo ta’u, Deenmaarkis bilisummaa fi abbaa biyyummaa ishee kabachiifatti. Walii galtichi walga’ii waliigalaa Tokkummaa Mootummootaa irratti kan mallatteeffamu yoo ta’u, hanga hojiirra oolutti mana maree Deenmaarkin raggaasifamuun isaa eegama.

title: Trump claims deal with Denmark gives US ‘permanent control’ over Greenland
english: President Donald Trump has announced a deal with Denmark and Greenland that he claims grants the United States permanent security control and the right to establish a major military presence there. While Trump asserts this agreement limits the influence of adversaries, officials in Denmark and Greenland state the pact is still subject to parliamentary approval. Danish leaders emphasize that the agreement will uphold the sovereignty of their kingdom and respect the rights of Greenland's people.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ከአሜሪካ ጋር ለዘላቂ የፀጥታ ቁጥጥር እና ለወታደራዊ ግንባታ የሚያስችል ስምምነት ከዴንማርክ እና ግሪንላንድ ጋር መፈራረማቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ይሁን እንጂ የዴንማርክ እና የግሪንላንድ ባለስልጣናት ስምምነቱ አሁንም በፓርላማ ማጽደቅ እንደሚጠብቀው ገልጸዋል። የዴንማርክ መሪዎች ስምምነቱ የግዛታቸውን ሉዓላዊነት እና የግሪንላንድ ህዝብ የራስን ዕድል በራስ የመወሰን መብት እንደሚያከብር አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Pirezidaanti Doolaald Tiraamp, Ameerikaan Gariinlaandii irratti too'annoo nageenyaa dhaabbataa akka argattuufi buufata waraanaa ijaarrachuu akka dandeessu kan ibsu waliigaltee biyyoota Deenmaarkiifi Gariinlaandii waliin mallatteessuu isaanii beeksisaniiru. Ta'us, hoggantoonni Deenmaarkiifi Gariinlaandii waliigalteen kun ammayyuu mana maree biyyoota isaaniitiin raggaasifamuu akka qabu ibsaniiru. Hoggantoonni Deenmaarkis waliigalteen kun kabaja biyya isaanii fi mirga uummata Gariinlaandii kan eegu ta'uu mirkaneessaniiru.

title: Brighton vs Arsenal: Premier League – predictions, teams, lineups
english: Defending Premier League champions Arsenal will travel to the Amex Stadium this Saturday to face Brighton. The league leaders aim to maintain their perfect start to the season and extend their current point advantage. Although there was past tension between managers Mikel Arteta and Fabian Hurzeler, both have moved past their previous disagreements ahead of this match.
amharic: የፕሪሚየር ሊጉ አሸናፊ አርሰናል በዚህ ቅዳሜ ብራይተንን ለመግጠም ወደ አሜክስ ስታዲየም ያመራል። ሊጉን በበላይነት እየመራ የሚገኘው አርሰናል፣ በውድድር ዘመኑ ያስመዘገበውን ድንቅ አጀማመር በመቀጠል የነጥብ ልዩነቱን ለማስፋት ያለመ ነው። የሁለቱ ቡድኖች አሰልጣኞች ሚኬል አርቴታ እና ፋቢያን ሁርዜለር ቀደም ሲል የነበራቸው አለመግባባት የተፈታ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Qophii itti aantuun waancaa Priimiyer Liigii Ingilizii Arsenal Dilbata dhufu kana tapha Brightoniin qabamee jiruuf gara dirree Amex Stadium imala. Gareen sadarkaa tokkoffaa irratti argamu kun xiqqaattuu qabxii isaa guddisuuf injifannoo isaa itti fufuu barbaada. Leenjisonni garee lameenii Mikel Arteta fi Fabian Hurzeler kanaan dura rakkoo gidduu isaanii ture akka irra darban ibsaniiru.

title: New cat species found, first in more than 100 years
english: Researchers have identified a new species of cat in the Yungas forest of Bolivia, marking the first discovery of its kind in over 100 years. This small creature, referred to locally as the Tilcayo, belongs to the tiger cat family. It is quite tiny, measuring only 18 inches in length and weighing approximately 3 pounds.
amharic: ተመራማሪዎች ከ100 ዓመታት በላይ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ በአዲሱ የቦሊቪያ የዩንጋስ ደን ውስጥ አዲስ የድመት ዝርያ አግኝተዋል። ቲልካዮ በመባል የሚታወቀው ይህ አነስተኛ እንስሳ የነብር ድመቶች ቤተሰብ ውስጥ የሚመደብ ነው። መጠኑም በጣም ትንሽ ሲሆን 18 ኢንች ርዝመት እና 3 ፓውንድ ያህል ክብደት አለው።
oromo: Qorattoonni bosona Yungas kan biyya Booliiviyaa keessatti gosa adurree haaraa waggaa 100 keessatti yeroo jalqabaatiif argame tokko adda baasaniiru. Adurreen kun kan naannichaatti 'Tilcayo' jedhamee waamamu, gosa adurree bineensaa (tiger cat) keessatti ramadama. Uumamni kun baay'ee xiqqaa yoo ta'u, dheerinni isaa incii 18 fi ulfaatinnii isaa paawundii 3 qofa.

title: Germany receives first F-35 jet from US as NATO boosts military spending
english: Germany has officially taken delivery of its first F-35A stealth fighter jet from the United States. This acquisition marks a significant step in modernizing the German Air Force and replacing its older aircraft fleet. The purchase is part of a larger commitment by Germany and other NATO nations to increase defense spending and enhance military capabilities.
amharic: ጀርመን የመጀመሪያውን የኤፍ-35ኤ ስውር የጦር ጀት ከአሜሪካ ተረክባለች። ይህ ድርጊት የጀርመን አየር ኃይልን ዘመናዊ ለማድረግ እና የቆዩ የጦር አውሮፕላኖችን ለመተካት ትልቅ እርምጃ ነው። ይህ ግዢ ጀርመን እና ሌሎች የኔቶ አባል ሀገራት የመከላከያ ወጪያቸውን ለመጨመር እና የጦር ኃይላቸውን ለማጠናከር ከወሰዱት ውሳኔ ጋር የተያያዘ ነው።
oromo: Jarmanii xiyyaarra waraana kan F-35A jedhamu kan duraa Ameerikaa irraa fudhatteetti. Bittaan kun humna qilleensa Jarmanii ammayyeessuufi xiyyaarota durii bakka buusuuf guddina guddaa dha. Bittaan kun biyyoonni Jarmaniifi miseensonni NATO biroo baasii ittisaa dabaluufi humna waraanaa cimsuuf murtoo taasisaniin kan walqabatu dha.

title: UK court clears woman of voicing support for Hamas in university speech
english: A London jury has acquitted 22-year-old student Sarah Cotte of charges related to expressing support for Hamas during a 2023 university speech. Prosecutors argued her comments about Palestinian resistance were intended to promote the banned group, but Cotte testified that she was advocating for Palestinian rights rather than supporting Hamas. The court's not-guilty verdict confirms she did not violate UK laws regarding the backing of designated terrorist organizations.
amharic: የለንደን ፍርድ ቤት የ22 ዓመቷን ተማሪ ሳራ ኮቴ በ2023 በዩኒቨርሲቲ ንግግሯ ወቅት ለሀማስ ድጋፍ ሰጥታለች በሚል የቀረበባትን ክስ ውድቅ አድርጎ ነፃ ለቋታል። አቃቤ ህግ የፍልስጤም ተቃውሞን በተመለከተ ያቀረበችው ንግግር ታግዶ ለሚገኘው ቡድን ድጋፍ ለመስጠት የታለመ ነው ቢልም፣ ተከሳሡ ግን ሀማስን ሳይሆን የፍልስጤምን ህዝብ መብት እንደምትደግፍ አስረድታለች። የፍርድ ቤቱ ብይን ተከሳሡ የሽብር ቡድኖችን በመደገፍ ላይ የተጣለውን የዩናይትድ ኪንግደም ህግ እንዳልጣሰች ያረጋግጣል።
oromo: Mana murtii Landanitti argamu tokko, barattuu waggaa 22 Sarah Cotte jedhamtu irratti himata bara 2023 yunivarsiitii keessatti dubbii taasisteen garee Haamaas deggerte jedhame dhiyaate irraa bilisa ishee baaseera. Abbaan alangaa, haasawni isheen falmii Palastiiyniirratti taasiste garee dhorkame kana deggeruufi jedhee kan falme ta'us, Sarah garuu ofii isheetiin anaa garee Haamaas utuu hin taane mirga uummata Palastiiyniitu na yaaddessa jedhee hubachiiseera. Murtii mana murtiitiin, gochi ishee kun seera UK kan garee shororkeessaa deggeruurratti bahe kan cabse miti jechuun mirkanaa'eera.

title: Saudi authorities lift danger alert for Farasan governorate
english: Saudi civil defense authorities have officially canceled the emergency alert previously issued for the Farasan governorate, declaring that the danger has passed. Similar warnings for other cities and regions across the country have also been removed. Residents are still encouraged to remain cautious and follow official safety guidelines provided by the authorities.
amharic: የሳዑዲ ሲቪል መከላከያ ባለስልጣናት ቀደም ሲል በፈራሳን ግዛት ላይ ተጥሎ የነበረው የአደጋ ማስጠንቀቂያ ማብቃቱን አስታውቀዋል። በተመሳሳይ በሌሎች የሀገሪቱ ከተሞችና ክልሎች ተጥለው የነበሩ ማስጠንቀቂያዎችም ተነስተዋል። ነዋሪዎች አሁንም ጥንቃቄ እንዲያደርጉና በመንግስት የሚሰጡትን የደህንነት መመሪያዎች እንዲከተሉ ተመክረዋል።
oromo: Abbootiin taayitaa ittisa balaa biyyattii naannoo Faraasaan irratti labsamee turee fi balaan darbuusaa ibsan. Akkasumas, magaalota fi naannolee biroo kanneen biyyattii keessatti labsamee turee fi yeroo ammaa kanneen kaafamanidha. Jiraattoonni qajeelfama mootummaan kennu hordofuun of eeggannoo cimaa akka taasisan gorfamaniiru.

title: Yemen governmnet accuses Houthis of attacks on humanitarian facilities
english: The Yemeni government has formally accused Houthi forces of raiding and damaging critical humanitarian infrastructure along the nation's western coast. These attacks allegedly destroyed clinics, medical supplies, and food storage facilities funded by Saudi Arabia. Officials warn that these actions severely threaten the well-being of thousands of displaced civilians who rely on these services for survival.
amharic: የየመን መንግስት የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በሀገሪቱ ምዕራባዊ ጠረፍ የሚገኙ የሰብአዊ እርዳታ ማዕከላትን በመዝረፍ እና በማውደም ከሰዋል። ጥቃቱ የተፈፀመው በሳዑዲ አረቢያ የገንዘብ ድጋፍ በሚደረግላቸው የህክምና ክሊኒኮች፣ የምግብ እና የመድኃኒት ማከማቻዎች ላይ ነው። እነዚህ ድርጊቶች በእርዳታ ላይ ጥገኛ የሆኑ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ተፈናቃዮችን ህይወት ለአደጋ እንደሚያጋልጥ መንግስት አስጠንቅቋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Yaman humnoota Huutii buufataalee gargaarsa namoomaa fi tajaajila fayyaa naannoo qarqara galaana lixaa keessatti argaman saamuudhaa fi miidhuun himateera. Qooda fudhattoonni mootumichaa akka jedhanitti, haleellaan kun kiliniiwwanii fi bakka qulqullinaa fi nyaata walitti qaban kan Sa'udii Arabiyaan deeggaraman irratti xiyyeeffateera. Gochi kun namoota buqqa'anii fi deeggarsa barbaadan kumaatamaan lakkaa'aman irratti miidhaa hamaa geessisuu danda'a jechuun mootummaan akeekkachiiseera.

title: US defence secretary calls Washington Post report on US troop deaths a ‘lie’
english: US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth has dismissed a Washington Post report claiming the Pentagon underreported American military casualties in the conflict with Iran. Hegseth publicly rejected the allegations on social media, labeling the story as completely false and offensive. The original report had cited anonymous officials to suggest that the actual death toll among US troops is higher than what has been officially disclosed.

oromo: Ministirri ittisa biyyaa Ameerikaa Piit Heegseet, gabaasa Waashingitan Post, waraana Ameerikaa fi Iraan gidduutti gaggeeffamaa jiruun duuti waraana Ameerikaa akka dhokfame dubbatu soba jedhaniiru. Ministirichi miidiyaa hawaasaa irratti akka ibsanitti, gabaasichi dhuga-qabeessa kan hin taane fi kan namaa gaddisiisuudha jedhaniiru. title: Saudi Arabia cancels oil shipments to European refineries
english: Saudi Arabia has notified several European refineries that their scheduled crude oil deliveries for October will not take place. This decision follows recent regional conflicts that have disrupted energy supply chains and prompted the use of force majeure clauses in existing contracts. Similar supply issues are currently affecting other parts of the region, including Qatar's liquefied natural gas shipments.

oromo: Saudii Arabiyaan kutaalee Awurooppaa kanneen ishee irraa boba'aa bitatanif, ji'a Onkololeessa keessa dhiyeessiin boba'aa akka adda citu beeksisteetti. Murteen kun kan dhufte walitti bu'iinsa naannichaa keessatti uumameen walqabatee rakkoon dhiyeessii uumamuu isaatiin walqabata. Haaluma wal fakkaatuun, dhimmi kun gabaa gaazii uumamaa biyyoota biroo irrattis dhiibbaa geessisaa jira.

title: Seoul reaffirms to US its intent to contribute to restoring Strait of Hormuz free passage
english: South Korean Foreign Minister Cho Hyun recently met with US Secretary of State Marco Rubio in Washington to discuss regional security. During the meeting, South Korea committed to playing a significant role in ensuring that international shipping remains unrestricted through the Strait of Hormuz. This pledge reinforces the ongoing cooperation between the two nations regarding maritime stability.
amharic: የደቡብ ኮሪያ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ቾ ሂዩን በዋሽንግተን ከአሜሪካ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ማርኮ ሩቢዮ ጋር ተገናኝተው በክልላዊ ደህንነት ጉዳዮች ላይ ተወያይተዋል። በዚህ ውይይት ወቅት ደቡብ ኮሪያ በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት በኩል የነፃ የንግድ መርከቦች እንቅስቃሴ እንዲረጋገጥ የበኩሏን አስተዋፅዖ ለማድረግ ቃል ገብታለች። ይህ ስምምነት በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል በባህር ላይ ደህንነት ዙሪያ ያለውን ትብብር ያጠናክራል።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimmi Alaa Kooriyaa Kibbaa Cho Hyun, Waashingitanitti Ministira Dhimmi Alaa Ameerikaa Maarkoo Ruubiyoo wajjin wal arguun dhimmoota nageenya naannichaa irratti mari’ataniiru. Marii kana irratti, Kooriyaan Kibbaa mirga bilisaa galaana keessa darbuu 'Strait of Hormuz' kabajsiisuuf gumaacha barbaachisaa ta’e gochuuf waadaa galteetti. Walii galteen kun hariiroo nageenya galaanaarratti biyyoota lamaan gidduu jiru kan cimsu dha.

title: Trump says he is banning CNN and Politico from White House
english: President Donald Trump has announced a ban on CNN, Politico, and MSNBC from entering the White House, accusing them of spreading false information about his administration. While the president described the action as a simple measure, it remains unclear how it will be enforced, and media organizations have condemned it as an unconstitutional attack on press freedom. The move is widely expected to face significant legal challenges as the affected networks continue to defend their reporting rights.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ስለ አስተዳደራቸው የሐሰት መረጃ ያስተላልፋሉ በሚል CNNን፣ Politicoን እና MSNBCን ከነጭ ቤተ መንግስት መከልከላቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ይህ እርምጃ በፕሬዝዳንቱ ቀላል ተብሎ የተገለፀ ቢሆንም እንዴት ተግባራዊ እንደሚሆን ግልጽ አይደለም፤ ሚዲያዎቹም ይህንን የፕሬስ ነፃነትን የሚጻረር ህገ-ወጥ ድርጊት ሲሉ አውግዘውታል። ጉዳዩ ወደፊት በህግ እንደሚታይ የሚጠበቅ ሲሆን፣ የሚዲያ ተቋማቱም የዘገባ መብታቸውን እንደማይለቁ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaant Doolaard Tiraamp gabaasawwan soba ta'an dhiyeessu jechuun dhaabbilee miidiyaa CNN, Politico fi MSNBC mana mootummaa (White House) keessa akka hin seenne dhorkaniiru. Tarkaanfichi sirna dimookiraasii fi mirga miidiyaa kan tuqu ta'uu isaa dhaabbileen miidiyaaleen kun ibsuun, kanneenis tarkaanfichaan mormaniiru. Akkaataa dhorkaan kun itti hojiirra ooluu malu hanga ammaa ifa kan hin taane yoo ta'u, dhimmi kun gara fuulduraatti seeraan kan falmamu ta'uun isaa ibsameera.

title: Is the Kennedy Center losing 'hundreds of millions of dollars'?
english: President Donald Trump has alleged that the Kennedy Center in Washington D.C. has been suffering from massive financial losses for years. However, official federal audit records from 2024 contradict these claims by showing that the venue maintained a multi-million dollar surplus when accounting for grants and donations. Although the center experienced an operating deficit, it remains financially stable overall.

title: ‘Daughter of Damascus’ Assala performs in Syria after 15-year exile
english: Renowned Syrian singer Assala Nasri recently held a sold-out concert in Damascus, marking her return to the country after a 15-year exile. She had previously left Syria due to her vocal opposition to the government of Bashar al-Assad during the 2011 uprising. Large crowds gathered to celebrate the homecoming of the iconic artist.
amharic: ታዋቂዋ የሶሪያ ድምጻዊት አሳላ ናስሪ ለአስራ አምስት ዓመታት በስደት ከቆየች በኋላ ወደ ሶሪያ በመመለስ ደማስቆ ውስጥ ታላቅ ኮንሰርት አቅርባለች። አርቲስቷ በ2011 የነበረውን የባሻር አል-አሳድ መንግስት ተቃውሞ በመደገፏ ለረጅም ጊዜ በስደት ትኖር ነበር። በኮንሰርቷ ላይም በርካታ የሶሪያ ህዝብ በመገኘት አቀባበል አድርገውላታል።
oromo: Weellistuun beekamtuun Siiriyaa Assala Nasri waggoota 15 booda biyyatti deebi'uun magaalaa Dimashq keessatti konsertii ishee gaggeeffattee jirti. Inni duriif mootummaa Bashar al-Assad irratti mormii ka'e deggeruun ishee biyyarraa baqachuuf ishee dirqisiisee ture. Yeroo isheen deebitu kanatti ummanni baay'een walgahanii gammachuudhaan simataniiru.

title: Syria arrests five former al-Assad-era officers over strikes on civilians
english: Syrian security forces have arrested five former air force officers, including a general, for their alleged involvement in conducting deadly airstrikes against civilians during the Bashar al-Assad regime. Authorities stated that these individuals directed attacks from airbases and command centers, resulting in widespread destruction and loss of life in populated areas. The suspects are currently under investigation and will face trial for their roles in these military operations.

title: Trump bans CNN, MS NOW, Politico from the White House for ‘fake news’
english: President Donald Trump has barred CNN, MS NOW, and Politico from accessing the White House, accusing them of spreading false information and negative reports about his administration. The President stated that these outlets intentionally publish lies to undermine his government, and he warned that further news organizations could face similar restrictions. In response, media representatives have defended their work as a constitutionally protected right, and legal challenges against this decision are expected.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ፣ ሲኤንኤን፣ ኤምኤስ ናው እና ፖለቲኮ የተባሉ የመገናኛ ብዙኃን በዋይት ሀውስ እንዳይገኙ አግደዋል። ፕሬዝዳንቱ እነዚህ ተቋማት አስተዳደራቸውን የሚያጠለሹ የሀሰት መረጃዎችን ሆን ብለው ያሰራጫሉ ሲሉ ከሰዋል። የመገናኛ ብዙኃን ተቋማቱ በበኩላቸው ይህ እርምጃ ህገ-መንግስታዊ መብታቸውን የሚጥስ መሆኑን በመግለጽ፣ ጉዳዩ በህግ አግባብ ሊታይ እንደሚችል ይጠበቃል።

title: Russian hybrid attacks against Europe intensifying, says Macron
english: French President Emmanuel Macron has warned of a rise in Russian hybrid threats, including cyberattacks and sabotage, aimed at destabilizing Europe. In response, France is implementing new measures to safeguard its critical infrastructure and defense sectors. Macron emphasized that these intimidation tactics will not weaken European support for Ukraine, as leaders across the continent remain concerned about potential Russian aggression.
amharic: የፈረንሳይ ፕሬዝዳንት አማኑኤል ማክሮን አውሮፓን ለማተራመስ ታስበው የሚፈጸሙ የሩሲያ የሳይበር ጥቃቶች እና መሰል የጥፋት ድርጊቶች እየጨመሩ መምጣታቸውን አስጠነቀቁ። ለዚህም ምላሽ ለመስጠት ፈረንሳይ ወሳኝ መሰረተ ልማቶቿን እና የመከላከያ ተቋማቷን ለመጠበቅ አዲስ እቅድ ዘርግታለች። ማክሮን እነዚህ የሩሲያ የዛቻ ሙከራዎች ለዩክሬን ያላቸውን ድጋፍ እንደማያዳክሙት ገልጸው፣ የአውሮፓ መሪዎች በሩሲያ ቀጣይ ጥቃት ላይ ስጋት እንዳላቸው አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Faransaay Imaanu'eel Maakroon, biyyoonni Awurooppaa miidhaa fi gidiraa Ruusiyaan karaa teknolojii fi saboota adda addaa fayyadamuun raawwattu daran dabalaa akka dhufe akeekkachiisaniiru. Kana hambisuufis, Faransaay bu'uuraalee misoomaa fi dhaabbilee ittisa biyyaa ishee eeguuf tarkaanfii haaraa fudhachuu jalqabdeetti. Maakroon, gochiin Ruusiyaa kun kanneen Yukreeniif deeggarsa kennan sodaachisuuf akka ta'e dubbatanii, garuu gargaarsi kun akka itti fufu mirkaneessaniiru.

title: Police begin operation to move migrants from Ceuta beaches
english: Spanish authorities have launched an operation to relocate thousands of migrants from Ceuta's beaches to a newly established tent facility at the local port. The process experienced initial chaos and crowd control difficulties, including reports of police firing warning shots to manage the situation. The government aims to centralize the migrants in this secure area to process their identification and legal status more effectively.

oromo: Hojjettoonni mootummaa Ispeen godina Se'uutaa keessatti qarqara galaanaatti qubatanii turan baqattoota kumaan lakkaa'aman gara buufata doonii naannichaa gara kaampii daasii haaraa qophaa'etti galchuuf sochiin eegaleera. Adeemsichi jalqabarratti jeequmsa uumee kan ture yoo ta'u, poolisoonni haalicha to'achuuf dhukaasa akeekkachiisaa dhukaasuu gabaafameera. Mootummaan baqattoota kana bakka tokkotti walitti qabuudhaan eenyummaasaanii mirkaneessuufi haala seeraa isaanii adda baasuuf akka isaan gargaaru kaayyoo godhateera.

title: Lindsay Clancy holdout juror says he had no doubt she deliberately killed her children
english: A juror in the Lindsay Clancy murder trial stated he was convinced she intentionally killed her three children, leading to a split in the jury's final decision. While Clancy's defense argued she suffered from postpartum psychosis, the holdout juror insisted that the evidence proved the acts were planned. This disagreement resulted in a mistrial after the other eleven jurors favored finding her not criminally responsible.
amharic: የሊንዚ ክላንሲን የፍርድ ሂደት ሲከታተል የነበረ አንድ ዳኛ፣ እናቶቹ ልጆቿን የገደለችው ሆን ብላ እንደሆነ ምንም ጥርጣሬ እንዳልነበረው ተናግሯል። የክላንሲ ጠበቆች ድርጊቱ የተፈፀመው በድህረ ወሊድ የአእምሮ መታወክ እንደሆነ ቢከራከሩም፣ የተቃዋሚው ዳኛ ግን ማስረጃው ግድያው የታቀደ መሆኑን እንደሚያሳይ ገልጸዋል። ሌሎች አስራ አንድ ዳኞች ክላንሲን በድርጊቷ ተጠያቂ አይደለችም በሚል አቋም በመያዛቸው ፍርድ ቤቱ የፍርድ ሂደቱ እንዲሰረዝ ወስኗል።
oromo: Abbaan seeraa tokko himata ajjeechaa Lindsay Clancy irratti hirmaachaa ture, haati kun ijoollee ishii sadiin fedhii guutuun ajjeesuushee shakkiin tokkollee akka hin qabne ibseera. Gareen ittisaa Clancy dhukkuba sammuu da'ummaa booda dhufuun miidhamtee akka turte dubbataniyyuu, abbaan seeraa kun garuu ragaan jiru ajjeechaan sun qophii irratti hundaa'e akka ture mirkaneessa jedheera. Miseensonni juriin kurnan fi tokko biroon Clancy itti gaafatamtuu miti jedhanii waan amananiif, dhaddachi kun murtoo tokko malee akka xumuramu ta'eera.

title: Police clear Ceuta migrants off beaches in Spanish enclave
english: Spanish police have launched an operation to remove thousands of migrants from beaches in the North African enclave of Ceuta following a massive border surge in July. While most of the 72,000 people who initially entered have left, approximately 10,000 remain, prompting authorities to move them into newly established temporary facilities at the port. European officials expressed concern that these high-profile crossings are strengthening support for far-right political movements across the continent.
amharic: የስፔን ፖሊስ በሰሜን አፍሪካ የምትገኘው ሴኡታ በተባለች ግዛታቸው የባህር ዳርቻዎች ላይ ሰፍረው የነበሩ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ስደተኞችን የማስወጣት ስራ ጀምሯል። በሐምሌ ወር ድንበር ጥሰው ከገቡት 72,000 ሰዎች መካከል አብዛኞቹ ቢወጡም፣ ወደ 10,000 የሚጠጉ ስደተኞች አሁንም እዚያው በመሆናቸው ባለስልጣናቱ ወደ ወደብ አካባቢ ወደተዘጋጁ ጊዜያዊ መጠለያዎች እያዛወሯቸው ነው። የአውሮፓ ህብረት ባለስልጣናት እነዚህ የስደተኞች መግባት ክስተቶች በአውሮፓ ውስጥ ለጽንፈኛ የቀኝ ክንፍ ፓርቲዎች ድጋፍ እየሰጡ መሆኑን በመግለጽ ስጋታቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Poolisiin Ispeen guutummaa magaalaa Se’uutaa keessatti godaantota kumaatamaan lakkaa’aman qarqara galaana irraa kaasuuf duula eegaleera. Hojjettootni Gamtaa Awurooppaa, godaantotni kun daangaa cabsuun isaanii biyyoota Awurooppaa keessatti gareewwan siyaasaa mirga-rareeffattotaaf deggarsa guddaa akka kennuuf yaaddoo qaban ibsaniiru.

title: Early in-person voting begins in the 2026 US midterm elections in Virginia
english: Virginia has officially started in-person early voting for the 2026 US midterm elections, marking a significant step in the national trend toward pre-election balloting. These elections are crucial for determining control of Congress during the remainder of President Trump's term. While states have different rules, the move toward early and mail-in voting continues to expand across the country despite ongoing legal disputes over election procedures.
amharic: ቨርጂኒያ ለ2026ቱ የአሜሪካ የመካከለኛ ዘመን ምርጫ ቀድሞ የመምረጥ ሂደትን በይፋ ጀምራለች። ይህ ሂደት በአሜሪካ የኮንግረስ አባላትን ለመወሰን ወሳኝ ሲሆን፣ የአገሪቱ አዝማሚያም በምርጫ ቀን ከመምረጥ ይልቅ ቀድሞ መምረጥ ላይ እያተኮረ ነው። ምንም እንኳን በምርጫ አሰራር ላይ ህጋዊ ክርክሮች ቢኖሩም፣ ቀድሞ የመምረጥ እና በፖስታ የመምረጥ እድሎች በአሜሪካ ግዛቶች እየተስፋፉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Virginia filannoo giddu-galeessa bara 2026 kan Amerikaaf sagalee kennuu iddoo deemanii dursee kennuu jalqabdeetti. Sagaleen kun miseensota Kongiresii filachuuf murteessaa yoo ta'u, biyyattis guyyaa filannoo dursee sagalee kennuun akka babal'atuuf carraaqqii gochaa jirti. Heerri fi seera filannoo irratti falmiiwwan seeraa yoo jiraatanis, sagalee dursee kennuu fi poostaan erguun kutaa biyyattii keessatti itti fufee babal'achaa jira.

title: Sweden’s left-wing opposition leader begins efforts to form government
english: Following the resignation of the previous Prime Minister, Swedish Social Democratic leader Magdalena Andersson has officially started negotiations to form a new government. Although her left-wing bloc secured a narrow majority in the recent election, she faces difficulty in uniting various political parties with conflicting demands. Andersson must reach an agreement by September 28th to successfully establish a cabinet.
amharic: የቀድሞው ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ከስልጣን መልቀቃቸውን ተከትሎ፣ የስዊድን የሶሻል ዴሞክራቲክ መሪ ማግዳሌና አንደርሰን አዲስ መንግስት ለመመስረት ድርድር ጀምረዋል። ምንም እንኳን የእርሳቸው የግራ ዘመም ጥምረት በቅርቡ በተካሄደው ምርጫ አነስተኛ ድል ቢቀዳጅም፣ የተለያዩ የፖለቲካ ፓርቲዎችን ፍላጎት ማጣጣም ከፍተኛ ፈተና ሆኖባቸዋል። አንደርሰን መንግስት ለመመስረት እስከ መስከረም 18 ቀን ድረስ ጊዜ አላቸው።
oromo: Pireezidaantiin duraanii gadi lakkisanii erga ba'anii booda, hogganaan paartii Sooshaal Diimookraatikii Siwiidin Maagdaaleenaa Aanḍarson mootummaa haaraa hundeessuuf marii eegalaniiru. Waldaan isaanii filannoo darbe keessa mo'annoo dhiphaa argatus, paartilee siyaasaa garaa garaa waliigaltee irra geessisuun isaan rakkisaa jira. Aanḍarson mootummaa hundeessuuf hanga Fulbaana 28tti yeroo qabu.

title: Iranians rally in biggest show of defiance against US since war began
english: Hundreds of thousands of Iranians gathered in Tehran for a government-organized demonstration to showcase national unity and military readiness against the United States. During the event, authorities introduced a new volunteer force that will receive training to support the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps. High-ranking officials emphasized that these efforts serve as a defensive strategy to protect the nation and deter potential foreign aggression.

oromo: Magaalaa Tehraanitti namoonni dhibbaan lakkaa'aman mootummaan qindeessee, tokkummaa biyyoolessaa fi qophiin waraanaa Ameerikaa irratti qaban agarsiisuuf hiriira bahaniiru. Saganticharratti mootummaan humni fedhii qaban haaraan ijaaramuu fi kunis humna waraana 'Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps' gargaaruuf leenji’uun akka qophaa'an ibseera. Hoggantoonni olaanoon biyyattii akka jedhanitti, tattaaffiin kun ticsa biyyaa fi diinota itti fiduuf kan qophaaye ta'uu ibsaniiru.

title: UEFA, CONCACAF challenge FIFA on reserves and demand $10m payout to members
english: Leaders from UEFA and CONCACAF have demanded that FIFA distribute $2.1 billion from its record-breaking $6 billion financial reserves to its 211 member nations. They argue that this payment of $10 million per member is feasible without external investment, challenging the necessity of a previously proposed project that aimed to sell stakes in FIFA competitions. This move reflects rising pressure on FIFA President Gianni Infantino regarding the organization's financial management and development funding strategies.
amharic: የ UEFA እና የ CONCACAF ኃላፊዎች ፊፋ በሪከርድ ደረጃ ከያዘው 6 ቢሊዮን ዶላር የገንዘብ ክምችት ውስጥ 2.1 ቢሊዮን ዶላሩን ለ211 አባል ሀገራት እንዲያከፋፍል ጠይቀዋል። እያንዳንዱ አባል ሀገር 10 ሚሊዮን ዶላር እንዲያገኝ የሚጠይቀው ይህ እቅድ፣ ፊፋ የውድድር ድርሻውን ለውጭ አካላት ለመሸጥ ያቀደው እቅድ አስፈላጊ አለመሆኑን የሚያሳይ ነው። ይህ ጥያቄ የፊፋ ፕሬዝዳንት ጂያኒ ኢንፋንቲኖ የገንዘብ አያያዝ እና የአባል ሀገራት የገንዘብ ድጋፍ ላይ ያለውን ጫና ከፍ አድርጎታል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni UEFA fi CONCACAF, FIFA qabeenya kuufamee jiru kan dolaara biliyoona 6 irraa harka qooda biliyoona 2.1 biyyoota miseensa isaa 211 ta'aniif akka hiru gaafataniiru. Miseensa tokkoon tokkoon isaaniif dolaara miiliyoona 10 kan qoodamu kun, FIFA dorgommiwwan isaa gurguruuf karoorfatee ture sun barbaachisaa akka hin turre kan mirkaneessuudha. Tarkaanfiin kun pirezidaantii FIFA Jiyaanii Infaantiinoo irratti dhiibbaa bulchiinsa faayinaansii fi gargaarsa miseensotaa ilaalchisee jiru kan guddisuudha.

title: US lifts sanctions on Eritrea with Red Sea in focus
english: The United States has removed sanctions on the Eritrean military, its ruling party, and several key officials that were originally imposed in 2021 due to the country's involvement in the Tigray war. This decision reflects Eritrea's growing strategic importance, as the US seeks to manage regional dynamics near the Red Sea and Yemen. By lifting these restrictions, the Biden administration is re-engaging with the nation, which occupies a vital location near the Bab el-Mandeb Strait.
amharic: አሜሪካ በኤርትራ ወታደራዊ ተቋማት፣ በገዢው ፓርቲ እና በከፍተኛ ባለስልጣናት ላይ ጥላ የነበረውን ማዕቀብ ማንሳቷን አስታውቃለች። ይህ ማዕቀብ በ2021 የኤርትራ ሰራዊት በኢትዮጵያው የትግራይ ግጭት መሳተፉን ተከትሎ የተጣለ ነበር። አሜሪካ ማዕቀቡን ያነሳችው ኤርትራ በቀይ ባህር ዳርቻ ያላትን ስልታዊ ቦታ በመጠቀም በአካባቢው የፖለቲካ ሁኔታ ላይ ተፅዕኖ ለመፍጠር በማሰብ ነው።
oromo: Amerikaa sagantaa adabbii diinagdee kanaan dura mootummaa Ertiraa, waraana biyyattii fi qondaaltota gurguddoo irratti buuftee turte kaasteetti. Adabbiin kun kan buufame bara 2021 waraana Tigraay keessatti hirmaannaa Ertiraan qabdu sababeeffachuun ture. Murtoon kun kan fudhatame, Ertiraan daangaa galaana diimaa irratti iddoo tarsiimawaa qabdu fayyadamuun dhiibbaa naannichaa to'achuuf akka ta'e ibsameera.

title: US redirects 105 vessels under Iran blockade
english: The United States Central Command has diverted 105 commercial ships as part of its ongoing naval blockade against Iran. The USS Boxer and its Marine unit are actively patrolling the Arabian Sea to carry out these enforcement operations. These measures are designed to ensure that all maritime traffic strictly follows the established blockade regulations.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ማዕከላዊ ዕዝ ኢራን ላይ በጣለው የባህር ማገጃ ምክንያት 105 የንግድ መርከቦችን አቅጣጫ ማስቀየሩን አስታውቋል። የዩኤስኤስ ቦክሰር መርከብ እና የባህር ኃይል ክፍሎቹ በዓረብ ባህር ላይ የባህር ማገጃውን የማስፈጸም ስራ እየሰሩ ይገኛሉ። ይህ እርምጃ የንግድ መርከቦች የተጣለባቸውን የቁጥጥር ህግጋት ሙሉ በሙሉ እንዲያከብሩ ለማድረግ ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Ajajni giddu galeessa Ameerikaa, duula galtee galaana irratti Iran irratti gaggeeffamuun walqabatee markaboota daldalaa 105 karaa irraa akka maqfamaniif dirqisiiseera. Markabni USS Boxer jedhamu fi gareen waraana galaanaa isaa, galaana Arabaa keessatti seera kana kabachiisuuf hojjachaa jiru. Tarkaanfiin kun markaboonni daldalaa hundi seera ugguraa bahe akka kabajan mirkaneessuuf kan gargaaruudha.

title: US approves visas for Iranian officials to attend United Nations General Assembly
english: The United States has granted visas to a limited number of Iranian officials, including President Masoud Pezeshkian, to attend the upcoming United Nations General Assembly in New York. However, the U.S. State Department emphasized that the delegation will face strict movement restrictions and is prohibited from engaging in luxury shopping while visiting. This decision comes amidst ongoing tensions, as the U.S. continues to impose new economic sanctions against Iranian entities and officials.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት የኢራኑን ፕሬዝዳንት መስኡድ 페ዜሽኪያንን ጨምሮ ለጥቂት የኢራን ባለስልጣናት በኒውዮርክ በሚካሄደው የተባበሩት መንግስታት ጠቅላላ ጉባኤ ላይ እንዲሳተፉ ቪዛ ሰጥቷል። ይሁን እንጂ የአሜሪካ የውጭ ጉዳይ መስሪያ ቤት የኢራን ልዑካን እንቅስቃሴ በኒውዮርክ ውስን እንደሚሆን እና የቅንጦት ግዢ እንዳይፈጽሙ መከልከላቸውን አስታውቋል። ይህ ውሳኔ የተላለፈው በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል ውጥረት በሰፈነበት እና አሜሪካ በኢራን ላይ አዳዲስ የኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀቦችን በምትጥልበት ወቅት ነው።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa pirezidaantii Iraan Masuud Pezeshkiyaan dabalatee qondaaltonni Iraan muraasni walgahii waliigalaa Tokkummaa Mootummootaa Niiw Yookitti taa'amu irratti akka argaman viizaa kenneefii jira. Haa ta'u malee, qondaaltonni kunneen bakka yaadan deemuu akka hin dandeenyeefi qabeenya qaalii bituu akka hin qabne mootummaan Ameerikaa akeekkachiiseera. Murtii kanaan duraa irratti, Ameerikaan Iraan irratti tarkaanfiifi san'iiwwan dinagdee haaraa fudhachuu itti fuufteetti.

title: Israeli strike on motorcycle kills one in Gaza City
english: An Israeli military strike targeting a motorcycle in the Sheikh Radwan district of Gaza City resulted in one fatality. Several other individuals were injured during the incident, including a child who remains in life-threatening condition. Medical staff at al-Shifa Hospital provided these details following the attack.
amharic: በጋዛ ከተማ በሼክ ራድዋን ሰፈር በሞተር ሳይክል ላይ በተፈጸመ የእስራኤል ጥቃት አንድ ሰው ህይወቱ አልፏል። በዚሁ ጥቃት አንድ ህፃንን ጨምሮ በርካታ ሰዎች ጉዳት የደረሰባቸው ሲሆን፣ ህፃኑም በአስጊ ሁኔታ ውስጥ እንደሚገኝ የአል-ሺፋ ሆስፒታል የህክምና ምንጮች አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Magala Gaza, ganda Sheikh Radwan keessatti xiyyaaraan Israa'el konkolaataa miilla lamaa (mootarsayikilii) irratti miidhaa geessisteen namni tokko du'eera. Miidhaa kanaan namoonni biroo hedduun kan madaa'an yoo ta'u, isaan keessaa ijoolleen tokko haala cimaa keessa akka jiran hospitaalli Al-Shifa beeksiseera.

title: Ben Gvir supporters hand out gun-shaped keyrings to Israeli students
english: During a mock election event at an Israeli high school, supporters of Minister Itamar Ben Gvir distributed gun-shaped keychains carrying the slogan 'Guns Save Lives.' School officials intervened to stop these individuals from giving out additional items shaped like nooses to the students. This controversial activity occurred as part of a political outreach effort associated with Ben Gvir’s party.
amharic: በእስራኤል ሁለተኛ ደረጃ ትምህርት ቤት በተካሄደ የፌዝ ምርጫ ወቅት የብሔራዊ ደኅንነት ሚኒስትሩ የኢታማር ቤን ግቪር ደጋፊዎች 'ሽጉጥ ሕይወትን ያድናል' የሚል ጽሑፍ ያለባቸው የሽጉጥ ቅርጽ ያላቸው ቁልፍ መያዣዎችን ለተማሪዎች አከፋፍለዋል። የትምህርት ቤቱ ርዕሰ መምህር ደጋፊዎቹ ከመሳሪያ ቅርጽ በተጨማሪ የሉፕ (የገመድ) ቅርጽ ያላቸውን ቁሳቁሶች ለተማሪዎች እንዳያከፋፍሉ ከልክለዋል። ይህ ድርጊት የቤን ግቪር የፖለቲካ ፓርቲ እንቅስቃሴ አካል ሆኖ በሁለተኛ ደረጃ ትምህርት ቤት ግቢ ውስጥ መፈጸሙ ቅሬታ አስነስቷል።
oromo: Mana barumsaa sadarkaa lammaffaa Israa'el keessatti walitti bu'iinsa uumamee ture keessatti, deggertoonni ministira nageenyaa Itamar Ben Gvir barattootaaf furtuu 'Qawween lubbuu baraara' jedhu qabuufi boca qawwee qabu raabsanii turan. Bulchaan mana barumichaa deggertoonni kun boca bo'oo (lafee qolaa) fakkaatuun akka hin raabsine ittisuun danda'ameera. Gochi kun partii Ben Gvir tti kan hidhata qabuufi sagantaa filannoo sobaa mana barumsichaa irratti kan raawwatame dha.

title: Three dead and eight injured in Philippines school shooting
english: A 16-year-old student shot and killed two classmates before taking his own life at a high school in the Philippines. Eight other students were wounded during the attack, with four of them currently listed in critical condition. Authorities have suspended classes in the area while they investigate the motive behind this tragic event, which marks the third school shooting in the country since June.
amharic: በፊሊፒንስ አንዲት ሁለተኛ ደረጃ ትምህርት ቤት ውስጥ የ16 ዓመት ተማሪ ሁለት የትምህርት ቤት ጓደኞቹን በጥይት ገድሎ ራሱንም አጥፍቷል። ጥቃቱ ሌሎች ስምንት ተማሪዎችን የጎዳ ሲሆን፣ አራቱ በአስጊ ሁኔታ ላይ ይገኛሉ። ባለስልጣናት በትምህርት ቤቱ የተከሰተውን አሳዛኝ ክስተት እየመረመሩ ሲሆን፣ በአካባቢው የነበሩ ትምህርቶችም እንዲቋረጡ አድርገዋል። ይህ በሀገሪቱ ከሰኔ ወር ወዲህ ሲከሰት ሶስተኛው የትምህርት ቤት የተኩስ አደጋ ነው።
oromo: Filippinsitti barataan umuriin isaa 16 ta'e tokko mana barumsaa sadarkaa lammaffaatti barattoota lama ajjeese booda ofis ajjeeseera. Miidhaan kun barattoota biroo saddeet irra ga'ee jira, isaan keessaa afur haala hamaa keessa jiru. Aangeyyoonni sababa yakka kanaa qorachaa jiran yoo ta'u, magaalaan sunis barnoota yeroof dhaabdee jirti. Kun erga ji'a Waxabajjii baranaatii jalqabee miidhaan akkanaa yeroo sadaffaaf mana barumsaatti yammuu raawwatamu dha.

title: At least 16 killed after vehicle loaded with explosives rams into Pakistan mosque
english: A suicide car bombing at a mosque in northwestern Pakistan has resulted in the deaths of at least 16 people, including five police officers. Security forces are currently engaged in an ongoing gun battle with the attackers near the Kohat district police headquarters. While no group has claimed responsibility for the assault, Pakistani officials have condemned the violence amidst a rising trend of militant attacks in the region.
amharic: በሰሜን ምዕራብ ፓኪስታን በሚገኝ መስጊድ ላይ በተፈፀመ ራስን በራስ የማጥፋት የቦምብ ጥቃት ቢያንስ 16 ሰዎች የተገደሉ ሲሆን ከሟቾቹ መካከል አምስት ፖሊሶች ይገኙበታል። የፀጥታ ኃይሎች በኮሃት ወረዳ ከሚገኘው የፖሊስ ዋና መሥሪያ ቤት አጠገብ ካሉ ጥቃት አድራሾች ጋር የተኩስ ልውውጥ እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ። እስካሁን ጥቃቱን የወሰደ አካል ባይኖርም፣ የፓኪስታን ከፍተኛ ባለስልጣናት በአካባቢው እየጨመረ የመጣውን የሽብር ጥቃት አውግዘዋል።
oromo: Masjiida gara kaaba-lixaa Paakistaanitti argamu tokkorratti namni of ajjeese konkolaataa boombii fe'een oofee seenuun qaqqabsiise kanaan, namoonni 16 ol yoo du'an, isaan keessaa shanan poolisoota. Humnoonni nageenyaa godina Koohaatitti argamuun haleeltotaa wajjin wal-waraannee kan jiran yoo ta'u, haleellaa kanaan walqabatee ammaaf namni itti gaafatame hin jiru. Bulchiinsi Paakistaan haleellaa kana balaaleffachuun, naannichatti haleellaan garee hidhattootaan raawwatamu dabaluu isaa ibsaniiru.

title: New wild cat species discovered - with only one known living member
english: Scientists have identified a new species of small spotted cat, known as Leopardus tilcayo, discovered in the forests of Bolivia. Although these felines were previously mistaken for other similar wild cats, DNA analysis confirmed their unique genetic makeup. Currently, only one individual, nicknamed Tigrino, is known to be alive, and experts hope this discovery will encourage better conservation efforts for small tiger cats in South and Central America.
amharic: ተመራማሪዎች በቦሊቪያ ደኖች ውስጥ በጄኔቲክ የተለየ የሆነ አዲስ የዱር ድመት ዝርያ ማግኘታቸውን አረጋግጠዋል። 'ሊዮፓርደስ ቲልካዮ' ተብሎ የሚጠራው ይህ ድመት ቀደም ሲል ተመሳሳይ ከሆኑ ሌሎች የዱር ድመቶች ጋር ግራ ተጋብቶ ነበር። በአሁኑ ጊዜ በሕይወት የሚገኘው አንድ አባል ብቻ ቢሆንም፣ ግኝቱ ለአነስተኛ የዱር ድመቶች ጥበቃ ትኩረት እንዲሰጥ ተስፋ ተጥሎበታል።
oromo: Qorattoonni bosona biyya Boliviyaa keessatti gosa adurree bosonaa haaraa ta'ee fi 'Leopardus tilcayo' jedhamu argachuu isaanii mirkaneessaniiru. Adurreen kun kanaan dura gosa adurree biroo wajjin wal fakkaatu jedhamee shakkamaa ture, garuu qorannoon DNA isaa gosa addaa ta'uu isaa agarsiiseera. Yeroo ammaa adurreen kun jiraachuu isaa kan beekamu tokko qofa yoo ta'u, qorattoonni argannoon kun eegumsa adurree bosonaa xixinnoo irratti xiyyeeffannoo akka argatu abdatu.

title: Dozens of suspected illegal miners die in Nigerian custody
english: Thirty-seven suspected illegal miners have died while in the custody of Nigeria's civil defense corps in Niger state. While authorities initially suggested a disease outbreak, witnesses and reports point to severe overcrowding and a lack of ventilation as the cause of the fatalities. A commander has been arrested, and the state governor has declared three days of mourning to honor those who lost their lives.
amharic: በናይጄሪያ ናይጀር ግዛት በህገ-ወጥ የማዕድን ስራ ተጠርጥረው በጸጥታ ሃይሎች ቁጥጥር ስር የነበሩ 37 ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል። የጸጥታ አካላት ለሞቱ ምክንያት የሆነው የበሽታ ወረርሽኝ ሊሆን እንደሚችል ቢገልጹም፣ የተጎጂ ቤተሰቦች ግን እስር ቤቱ እጅግ መጨናነቁና አየር ማናፈሻ አለመኖሩ ለሰዎች ሞት ምክንያት እንደሆነ ተናግረዋል። በአደጋው ሳቢያ አንድ የጸጥታ አዛዥ በቁጥጥር ስር የዋሉ ሲሆን፣ የክልሉ አስተዳደርም የሶስት ቀናት የሀዘን መግለጫ አውጇል።
oromo: Naayijeeriyaatti namoonni 37 ta’an kanneen hojii maayiningii seeraan alaa irratti hirmaataniiru jedhamanii shakkaman, harka humnoota nageenyaa biyyattii keessatti du’an. Qaamoleen nageenyaa du’ichi dhukkuba hammaata irraa kan dhufe ta’uu ibsaniyyuu, maatiin namoota du’anii garuu hidhaan sun akka malee cufaa fi qilleensi kan hin seenne waan ta’eef namoonni sun akka dhumatan himaniiru. Ajajaan humna nageenyaa tokko qabamee qorannoon eegalameera; mootummaan naannichaa guyyoota sadiif gadda biyyoolessaa labseera.

title: Japan raises interest rate to new 31-year high to curb rising prices
english: The Bank of Japan has increased its benchmark interest rate to 1.25%, marking a 31-year high as the country moves away from long-term ultra-low borrowing costs. This decision aims to combat rising inflation driven by global energy price hikes and follows a series of rate increases started in 2024. By tightening monetary policy, the central bank hopes to stabilize the economy and address challenges like a weak currency and supply chain disruptions.
amharic: የጃፓን ማዕከላዊ ባንክ ለረጅም ጊዜ ሲከተል የነበረውን ዝቅተኛ የወለድ ምጣኔ በመተው ዋናውን የወለድ ምጣኔ ወደ 1.25 በመቶ ከፍ አድርጓል። ይህ ውሳኔ ባለፉት 31 ዓመታት ውስጥ ከፍተኛው ሲሆን፣ ዓለም አቀፍ የነዳጅ ዋጋ ጭማሪ ያስከተለውን የዋጋ ግሽበት ለመቆጣጠር ታቅዶ የተወሰደ እርምጃ ነው። ባንኩ ከ2024 ጀምሮ በተከታታይ የወለድ ምጣኔውን ሲያሳድግ የቆየ ሲሆን፣ ይህም የሀገሪቱን የኢኮኖሚ ተግዳሮቶች ለመቅረፍ እና የጃፓን የመገበያያ ገንዘብን ለማጠናከር ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Baankiin giddu galeessa Japaan gatii dhalaan (interest rate) gara 1.25% ol kaaseera; kunis waggaa 31 keessatti kan jalqabaa ta'ee fi biyyattiin siyaasa dhalaan isaa gadi bu'aa ta'e irraa akka fagaattu kan godhuudha. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame gatiin boba'aa addunyaa irraa ol ka'uun fedhii gabaa keessatti gatiin meeshaalee akka dabalu waan taasiseef, kana to'achuuf gargaara. Baankiin kun bara 2024 irraa eegalee suuta suutaan dhalaan dabalaa kan ture yoo ta'u, kaayyoon isaas diinagdee biyyattii tasgabbeessuu fi gatii maallaqa Japaan cimsuudha.

title: Deadly blast hits mosque at Pakistan police complex
english: A violent terrorist attack occurred at a mosque located within a police facility in northwest Pakistan. The incident involved an explosives-filled vehicle crashing into the entrance, which was followed by gunfire and a secondary suicide bombing. Multiple fatalities have been confirmed as a result of the coordinated assault.
amharic: በሰሜን ምዕራብ ፓኪስታን በሚገኝ የፖሊስ ግቢ ውስጥ በሚገኝ መስጊድ ላይ አሰቃቂ የሽብር ጥቃት ደረሰ። ጥቃቱ የተፈጸመው ፈንጂ የጫነ መኪና በግቢው መግቢያ ላይ በመጋጨቱ ሲሆን፣ በመቀጠልም የተኩስ ልውውጥና ሁለተኛ የራስን ማጥፋት የቦምብ ፍንዳታ ተከስቷል። በዚህ የተቀናጀ ጥቃት በርካታ ሰዎች ህይወታቸውን ማጣታቸው ተረጋግጧል።
oromo: Kaaba-dhiha Paakistaanitti masgiida buufata poolisii tokko keessa jiru irratti haleellaan qaama shororkeessaa cimaan raawwatameera. Haleellaan kun kan jalqabe konkolaataa meeshaa waraanaa fe'ateen balbala buufatichaa rukutuudhaan yoo ta'u, itti aansuudhaanis dhukaasaa fi haleellaa of ajjeesuu lammaffaa hordofee jira. Haleellaa qindeeffame kanaan lubbuun namoota hedduu darbuun mirkanaa'eera.

title: Who gets to decide how quickly AI moves?
english: Leaders of major AI companies like OpenAI and Anthropic are calling for a slower pace in developing advanced artificial intelligence, citing concerns about safety and inadequate safeguards. However, critics suggest these companies may be seeking to consolidate their market power rather than purely focusing on ethics. Other tech giants, such as Nvidia and Meta, argue against such restrictions, noting that competition and market forces should drive innovation instead of top-down regulation.
amharic: እንደ OpenAI እና Anthropic ያሉ ዋና ዋና የቴክኖሎጂ ኩባንያ መሪዎች የደህንነት ስጋቶችን በመጥቀስ የሰው ሰራሽ አስተውሎት ወይም AI ልማት በዝግታ እንዲቀጥል ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። ይሁን እንጂ ተቺዎች እነዚህ ኩባንያዎች ይህን የሚያደርጉት ለሥነ-ምግባር ሳይሆን የገበያ የበላይነታቸውን ለማጠናከር እንደሆነ ይከራከራሉ። በሌላ በኩል እንደ Nvidia እና Meta ያሉ ሌሎች ግዙፍ ኩባንያዎች፣ ቁጥጥር ከማድረግ ይልቅ ውድድር እና የገበያ ኃይሎች ለፈጠራ መሪ መሆን እንዳለባቸው በመግለጽ ይህንን ሃሳብ ይቃወማሉ።
oromo: Hoggantoonni dhaabbilee teeknoolojii gurguddoo kanneen akka OpenAI fi Anthropic, yaaddoo nageenyaa kaasuun guddina 'Artificial Intelligence' (AI) suuta akka adeemsiifamu gaafachaa jiru. Haa ta'u malee, qaamonni biroo yaada kana mormuun, dhaabbileen kun bu'aa ofii isaanii tiksuuf malee nageenyaaf jedhanii akka hin taane dubbatu. Gama biraatiin, dhaabbileen akka Nvidia fi Meta, guddina AI irratti danqaan seeraa yoo godhame, dorgommii gabaa fi kalaqni akka miidhamu ibsuun, fedhiin gabaa akka gara fuulduraatti nu geessu hubachiisu.

title: North Korea anthem played at South’s Bangladesh hockey match at Asian Games
english: During a field hockey match at the Asian Games in Japan, organizers mistakenly played the North Korean national anthem instead of the South Korean one. The South Korean players appeared confused by the error, which was quickly followed by an apology from the stadium announcer. This incident adds to a series of complaints regarding organizational issues at the event.
amharic: በጃፓን እየተካሄደ በሚገኘው የእስያ ጨዋታዎች ላይ የደቡብ ኮሪያ የወንዶች ሆኪ ቡድን በጨዋታው መጀመሪያ ላይ የራሳቸው መዝሙር ሲጠበቅ የሰሜን ኮሪያ ብሄራዊ መዝሙር መጫወቱ ግራ መጋባትን ፈጥሯል። የስታዲየሙ አስተዋዋቂ ስህተቱ እንደተፈጠረ ይቅርታ የጠየቀ ሲሆን፣ ይህ ክስተት በውድድሩ ላይ ከተስተዋሉ ሌሎች የአደረጃጀት ጉድለቶች መካከል አንዱ ሆኗል።
oromo: Jappaanitti tapha Asiin Geemsi jedhamu irratti, gurmeessitoonni taphichaa tapha biyya Kooriyaa Kibbaa dura faarfannaa biyyaalessaa Kooriyaa Kaabaa dogoggoraan taphachiisaniiru. Taphattoonni Kooriyaa Kibbaa dogoggora kanaan miira wal-dhabbiin keessa seenan yoo ta'u, gurmeessitoonni yeruma sana dhiifama gaafataniiru. Hanqinni kun rakkoolee qophii Asiin Geemsi irratti mul'ataa turan keessaa isa tokko dha.

title: Palmer and Alexander-Arnold recalled after England World Cup snub
english: England head coach Thomas Tuchel has called up Cole Palmer and Trent Alexander-Arnold for the upcoming Nations League matches following their exclusion from the recent World Cup squad. While these two stars return to the team, Phil Foden, Harry Maguire, and Luke Shaw remain left out. The squad also features new inclusions like teenager Rio Ngumoha as England prepares to face teams including Spain and Croatia.
amharic: የእንግሊዝ ብሔራዊ ቡድን አሰልጣኝ ቶማስ ቱኸል ለዓለም ዋንጫው ስብስብ ውስጥ ያልተካተቱትን ኮል ፓልመርን እና ትሬንት አሌክሳንደር አርኖልድን ለቀጣዩ የኔሽንስ ሊግ ጨዋታዎች መልሰው ጠርተዋል። ምንም እንኳን እነዚህ ተጫዋቾች ወደ ቡድኑ ቢመለሱም ፊል ፎደን፣ ሃሪ ማጉዋየር እና ሉክ ሾው አሁንም ከስብስቡ ውጪ ሆነዋል። አሰልጣኙ ከእነዚህ ተጫዋቾች በተጨማሪ ወጣቱን ተጫዋች ሪዮ ንጉሞሃን ጨምሮ አዳዲስ ተጫዋቾችን በመያዝ ስፔን እና ክሮኤሺያን የመሳሰሉ ጠንካራ ቡድኖችን ለመግጠም እየተዘጋጁ ነው።
oromo: Leenjisaan garee biyyoolessa Ingiliz Tomaas Tuuhe, taphattoota waancaa addunyaaf filatamanii hin turre Kol Paalmar fi Tireent Aleeksaandar-Arnoold taphoota 'Nations League' dhufuuf gara garee biyyoolessaatti deebiseera. Gareen kun yoo deebi'anis, Fiil Foodan, Haarii Maaguwaayir fi Luuk Shoow ammas filannoo keessa hin jiran. Kanas malee, leenjisaan kun taphataa dargaggeessa Rio Ngumoha dabalatee taphattoota haaraa gara gareetti fideera; kunis taphoota isaan Ispeen fi Kirooshiyaa waliin taasisanuf kan gargaaru dha.

title: United Nations says US may have committed war crimes in Iran: What it means
english: A UN-backed investigation has concluded that the US may have committed war crimes by striking a primary school and a sports center in Iran during February 2026. Evidence gathered from satellite imagery and witness accounts suggests these sites were not legitimate military targets, resulting in significant civilian casualties, including many children. While the White House has denied these allegations, investigators maintain that the attacks were carried out with reckless disregard for civilian safety.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት ባካሄደው ምርመራ፣ አሜሪካ በየካቲት 2026 በአን ግዛት ላይ ባደረሰችው ጥቃት የጦር ወንጀል ፈጽማ ሊሆን እንደሚችል አስታውቋል። ምርመራው እንደሚያሳየው በኢራን በሚናብ የመጀመሪያ ደረጃ ትምህርት ቤት እና በስፖርት ማዕከል ላይ የተፈጸመው ድብደባ ህጻናትን ጨምሮ በርካታ ንፁሃን ዜጎችን ህይወት ቀጥፏል። አሜሪካ የሰነዘረችውን ክስ ውድቅ ብታደርግም፣ መርማሪዎቹ ጥቃቱ የሲቪል ህዝብን ደህንነት ባለማገናዘብ በቸልተኝነት የተፈጸመ መሆኑን አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Qorannoon tokkummaa mootummootaa akka ibsetti, Ameerikaan gaafa Gurraandhala bara 2026 Iran keessatti mana barnootaa fi bakka ispoortii irratti haleellaa raawwatte yakka waraanaa ta'uu mala jedhamee shakkameera. Ragaaleen qindaa'an akka agarsiisanitti, haleellaan kunneen barattootaa fi namoota nagaa hedduu ajjeeseera. Ameerikaan himannaa kana kan haalte ta'us, qorattoonni haleellaan kun nageenya namoota nagaa eeguu dhabuun akka raawwatame mirkaneessaniiru.

title: Former Palestinian minister claims he warned Israel ahead of 7 October attack
english: Former Palestinian official Sufian Abu Zaida has revealed that he acted as a mediator to warn Israeli intelligence of an impending threat from Hamas leader Yahya Sinwar weeks before the October 7 attack. Sinwar allegedly threatened to cause an 'earthquake' if negotiations regarding long-term agreements failed. While reports suggest this information may have reached Israeli leadership through regional allies, the details surrounding the communication remain a subject of intense public discussion.
amharic: የቀድሞው የፍልስጤም ባለስልጣን ሱፊያን አቡ ዘይዳ በጥቅምት 7 ጥቃት ከሳምንታት በፊት የሀማሱ መሪ ያህያ ሲንዋር ሊያደርሱት ስላሰቡት አደጋ ለእስራኤል መረጃ ሰጪዎች ማስጠንቀቂያ ማስተላለፋቸውን ገልጸዋል። ሲንዋር ከእስራኤል ጋር የሚደረጉ የረጅም ጊዜ ድርድሮች ካልተሳኩ 'የምድር መናወጥ' እንደሚያስከትሉ አስፈራርተው ነበር። ምንም እንኳን ይህ መረጃ በተለያዩ መንገዶች ለእስራኤል መሪዎች ደርሷል የሚባሉ ዘገባዎች ቢኖሩም፣ ጉዳዩ አሁንም በስፋት እየተወያዩበት ይገኛል።
oromo: Hogganaan duraanii Falastiin Sufiyaan Abuu Zayidaa, haleellaa Sadaasa 7 dura torbanoota hedduu, hogganaan Hamaas Yahyaa Sinwaar miidhaa guddaa geessisuu akka qaban gorsaafi akeekkachiisaa gara ogeeyyota basaasaa Israa'elitti dabarsuu isaanii ibsaniiru. Sinwaar mariin Israa'el waliin ta'u bu'aa dhabnaan 'sochii lafaa' ykn rakkoo guddaa akka uuman doorsisanii turan. Ragaan kun karaa garaa garaatiin gara hogganoota Israa'el ga'eera jedhamee kan gabaasame yoo ta'u, dhimmi kun ammas marii cimaa keessa jira.

title: Turkey to halt Iranian Mahan Air flights over US sanctions risk
english: Turkey has decided to ban Mahan Air flights starting September 21 to avoid further penalties from the United States. This move follows US sanctions against Turkish companies that provided ground and logistics support to the Iranian airline. While not a total ban on all Iranian carriers, the decision aims to protect Turkish businesses from being caught in future international enforcement actions.
amharic: ቱርክ በአሜሪካ የጣለችባትን ማዕቀብ ለማስቀረት ሲባል ከሴፕቴምበር 21 ጀምሮ የማሃን ኤር በረራዎችን ለማገድ ወስናለች። ይህ ውሳኔ የተላለፈው የአሜሪካ መንግስት ለኢራኑ አየር መንገድ ድጋፍ ያደረጉ የቱርክ ኩባንያዎችን መቅጣቱን ተከትሎ ነው። ውሳኔው በሁሉም የኢራን አየር መንገዶች ላይ ያነጣጠረ ባይሆንም፣ የቱርክ የንግድ ተቋማት ከቀጣይ የገንዘብ ቅጣቶች እንዲጠበቁ ለማድረግ ታቅዶ የተወሰደ እርምጃ ነው።
oromo: Turkiin adaba ykn sanqoonni Ameerikaa ishee irra gahuu danda'u hambisuuf jecha, balaliin xiyyaara Mahan Air kan gara biyyattii godhamu Fulbaana 21 irraa eegalee akka dhaabbatu murteessiteetti. Murteen kun kan dhufey, dhaabbileen Turkiin kan xiyyaara Iraan kanaaf tajaajila lafa irratti kennan adabbiin Ameerikaa irratti erga fudhatamee booda. Murteen kun xiyyaarota Iraan hunda kan dhabamsiisu miti, garuu dhaabbileen Turkiin adabbii gara fuulduraa irraa akka ittifaman gargaaruuf kan fudhatameedha.

title: Ms Rachel matches Macklemore with $1m donation for Palestinian children
english: Popular children's content creator Ms Rachel has pledged to donate $1 million to the Palestine Children’s Relief Fund. She made this decision to match a recent donation from rapper Macklemore and is urging other wealthy public figures to contribute as well. Both artists are using their platforms to highlight the humanitarian crisis and advocate for the lives of children in Gaza.
amharic: ታዋቂዋ የህጻናት ፕሮግራም አቅራቢ ሚስ ራቸል ለፍልስጤም ህጻናት መርጃ ድርጅት አንድ ሚሊዮን ዶላር ለመለገስ ቃል ገብታለች። ይህንን ውሳኔ ያደረገችው ድምጻዊ ማክለሞር ካደረገው ተመሳሳይ ልገሳ ጋር በመቀላቀል ሲሆን፣ ሌሎች ባለጸጋ ታዋቂ ሰዎችንም ተመሳሳይ እርምጃ እንዲወስዱ ጥሪ አቅርባለች። ሁለቱም አርቲስቶች በጋዛ እየደረሰ ያለውን የሰብአዊ ቀውስ ትኩረት ለመሳብ እና የህጻናትን ህይወት ለመታደግ ያላቸውን መድረክ እየተጠቀሙ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Qopheessituun sagantaa ijoollee beekamtuun Ms Rachel, qarshii miiliyoona tokko dhaabbata gargaarsa ijoollee Palestineef akka kennitu waadaa galteetti. Murtii kana kan goote, raapparii Macklemore gumaacha inni kanaan dura godhe hordofuudhaan yoo ta'u, namoota beekamoo qabeenya qaban biroo akkasumas gumaacha akka godhan gaafatteetti. Artistoonni kunneen lameenuu dhimma ijoollee Gazaatiif xiyyeeffannoo kennuufi jireenya isaanii tiksuuf carraa qabanitti fayyadamaa jiru.

title: Smotrich calls for expanding West Bank settlement policies to Israel’s north and south
english: Israeli Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich has proposed extending the settlement policies currently used in the West Bank to the Galilee and Negev regions. He argues that increasing Jewish settlement in these areas is necessary to prevent future security threats and counter internal opposition. The minister's plan involves creating new communities and agricultural sites in regions where Palestinian citizens of Israel currently reside.
amharic: የእስራኤል የገንዘብ ሚኒስትር ቤዛሌል ስሞትሪች በአሁኑ ጊዜ በምዕራብ ባንክ የሚተገበረውን የሰፈራ ፖሊሲ ወደ ገሊላ እና ነጌቭ አካባቢዎች ለማስፋፋት አቅደዋል። ሚኒስትሩ ይህንን እርምጃ የወሰዱት ለወደፊት ሊከሰቱ የሚችሉ የደህንነት ስጋቶችን ለመከላከል እና በአካባቢው ያለውን ተቃውሞ ለመግታት በሚል ነው። ዕቅዱ በአረብ እስራኤላውያን በሚኖሩባቸው አካባቢዎች አዳዲስ የአይሁድ ሰፈሮችን እና የእርሻ ቦታዎችን መመስረትን ያካትታል።
oromo: Ministirri Maallaqa Israa'el Bezalel Smotrich, imaammata qubannaa amma naannoo West Bank keessatti hojiirra oolu gara naannolee Galiilaa fi Negeviitti babal'isuuf karoorfataniiru. Ministirichi tarkaanfiin kun balaa nageenyaa gara fuulduraatti mudachuu danda'u ittisuufi mormii keessoo jiraatu hambisuuf barbaachisaa akka ta'e dubbatu. Karoorichi kun naannolee lammiileen Israa'el kan ta'an Arabaan keessa jiraatanitti qubannaa fi lafa qonnaa haaraa hundeesuu kan of keessatti qabatuudha.

title: UK warns British settlers in occupied West Bank of possible sanctions
english: The British government has informed its citizens living in West Bank settlements that they may soon face financial penalties due to a new sanctions policy. Officials emphasized that these settlements violate international law and warned residents to avoid any economic involvement in the area. While current estimates suggest a small number of British nationals live there, the government is strictly enforcing its updated stance against such settlement activity.
amharic: የብሪታንያ መንግስት በዌስት ባንክ ሰፈራዎች ውስጥ ለሚኖሩ ዜጎቹ በአዲሱ የቅጣት ህግ መሰረት ማዕቀብ ሊጣልባቸው እንደሚችል አስጠንቅቋል። መንግስት እነዚህ ሰፈራዎች አለም አቀፍ ህግን የሚቃረኑ መሆናቸውን በመግለጽ ነዋሪዎች ከኢኮኖሚያዊ እንቅስቃሴ እንዲቆጠቡ አሳስቧል። ምንም እንኳን በዚያ የሚኖሩ የብሪታንያ ዜጎች ቁጥር አነስተኛ እንደሆነ ቢገመትም፣ ለንደን በሰፈራ እንቅስቃሴዎች ላይ ያላትን አቋም እያጠነከረች ትገኛለች።
oromo: Mootummaan Biritish lammiilee isaa naannoo West Baank jiraatan irratti seera haarawaa baasuun tarkaanfiin adabbii akka fudhatamuufi akeekkachiiseera. Mootummaan kun qubannoon akkanaa seera idil-addunyaa kan cabsu waan ta'eef, lammiileen isaa hojii diinagdee kamiyyuu keessa akka hin galle gorseera. Lakkoofsi lammiilee Biritish achi jiraatan xiqqaa ta'us, mootummaan sun sochii qubannoo kana irratti qabu cimaa deemuu ibseera.

title: Oman oil escape route: How ship-to-ship transfers work — despite big risks
english: Saudi Arabia is using ship-to-ship oil transfers near Oman's Sohar port to bypass the Strait of Hormuz, which has been blocked by Iran amid regional conflict. By moving crude oil from Saudi tankers to other vessels outside the blockade, the kingdom can continue exports despite the closure of critical shipping routes. While this method allows essential trade to persist, it carries significant operational and safety risks.
amharic: ሳውዲ አረቢያ በኢራን የውጥረት አካባቢዎች ምክንያት የተዘጋውን የሆርሙዝ የባህር መተላለፊያ በኦማን የሶሃር ወደብ በኩል በማለፍ ዘይት እየላከች ትገኛለች። የሳውዲ ነዳጅ ጭነው የሚመጡ መርከቦች ጭነታቸውን ወደ ሌላ መርከብ በማዛወር የንግድ ልውውጣቸውን እንዲቀጥሉ የሚያስችል ዘዴ እየተጠቀሙ ነው። ይህ አማራጭ መንገድ የሳውዲን የነዳጅ ንግድ ለማስቀጠል ቢረዳም፣ ሂደቱ ግን ከፍተኛ የደህንነት ስጋቶችን የያዘ ነው።
oromo: Saudii Arabiyaan gamtaa naannichaa keessatti sababa jeequmsaatiin balbala galaana Hormuz waan cufameef, boba'aa ishee erguuf buufata Sohaar kan Omaan fayyadamaa jirti. Mannaajonni boba'aa Saudii boba'aa isaanii dooniiwwan biroo irratti naquudhaan karaan kun akka cufamee jiruutti daldala itti fufsiisaa jiru. Mala kun daldala boba'aa ishee cimsachuu kan dandeessise ta'us, adeemsichi riskiiwwan nageenyaa fi teeknikaa guddaa kan qabu dha.

title: Russia’s parliamentary election: Who’s on the ballot, and why it matters
english: Russia is holding parliamentary elections from Friday to Sunday to select members of the State Duma amid the ongoing conflict in Ukraine and economic challenges. President Vladimir Putin’s ruling United Russia party is widely expected to maintain its firm control over the legislature. Critics suggest the process lacks real competition, as there are no genuine opposition candidates on the ballot.
amharic: ሩሲያ በዩክሬን ጦርነት እና በኢኮኖሚ ተግዳሮቶች መካከል የፓርላማ አባላትን ለመምረጥ ከዓርብ እስከ እሁድ ምርጫ እያካሄደች ነው። የፕሬዚዳንት ቭላድሚር ፑቲን ገዢ ፓርቲ የሆነው 'ዩናይትድ ሩሲያ' በፓርላማው ላይ ያለውን የበላይነት እንደሚያስጠብቅ ይጠበቃል። ተቺዎች በምርጫው ላይ እውነተኛ ተቃዋሚዎች ባለመኖራቸው ሂደቱ ተወዳዳሪነት የጎደለው እንደሆነ ይናገራሉ።
oromo: Raashiyaan waraana Yukreenii fi rakkoo dinagdee keessa osoo jirtuu, miseensota mana maree biyyattii filachuuf guyyoota sadiif filannoo gaggeessaa jirti. Paartiin bulchaa jiru kan pirezidaant Putiin, 'Yuunaytid Raashiyaa' jedhamu, sadarkaa duraa irratti akka itti fufuufi kan eeggamuudha. Morkattoonni immoo filannicha keessatti morkattoonni dhugaa waan hin jirreef, filannichi bilisa akka hin taane dubbatu.

title: UN mission alleges crimes against humanity in Iranian protest crackdown
english: A United Nations investigation has determined that Iranian authorities carried out crimes against humanity while suppressing public demonstrations. The report confirms accounts of extreme violence and excessive force used by security forces, particularly during the peak of the crackdown. This official finding supports testimonies from witnesses who experienced the state's aggressive response firsthand.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት ባደረገው ምርመራ የኢራን የጸጥታ ኃይሎች ተቃውሞዎችን ለመቆጣጠር በሚያደርጉት ጥረት የሰው ልጆችን መብት የሚጥሱ ወንጀሎችን መፈጸማቸውን አስታውቋል። ሪፖርቱ በስልጣን ላይ ያሉት አካላት በተለይም በተቃውሞው ከፍተኛ ደረጃ ላይ በነበሩበት ወቅት ከፍተኛ ጥቃት መፈጸማቸውን ያረጋግጣል። ይህ ግኝት በግጭቱ ወቅት በደል የደረሰባቸውን ሰዎች ምስክርነት የሚያጠናክር ነው።
oromo: Mootummoonni Gamtooman qorannoo taasisaniin, humnoonni nageenyaa Iraan mormii uummataa ukkamsuuf jecha yakka namoomaa irratti raawwatanii jiru. Gabaasichi, humnoonni mootummaa keessattuu yeroo mormiin cimaa turetti tarkaanfii suukkanneessaa fudhachuu isaanii mirkaneesseera. Qorannoon kun ragaalee namoota miidhaan irra gahe irraa argaman kan deeggaruudha.

title: South Korea says US-North Korea talks possible, rules out Hormuz deployment
english: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung announced that his country is working to help restart dialogue between the United States and North Korea, noting that President Trump remains open to discussions. At the same time, the President firmly rejected pressure to send military forces to the Strait of Hormuz, emphasizing that South Korea will not participate in the conflict. This stance highlights Seoul's focus on maintaining regional stability and avoiding direct involvement in foreign wars.
amharic: የደቡብ ኮሪያው ፕሬዚዳንት ሊ ጃኤ ሙንግ በዩናይትድ ስቴትስ እና በሰሜን ኮሪያ መካከል የተቋረጠውን ውይይት እንደገና ለማስጀመር ጥረት እያደረጉ መሆናቸውን ገልጸዋል። ከዚህ ጎን ለጎን ደቡብ ኮሪያ በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት ላይ ወታደራዊ ኃይል እንደማትልክ በግልጽ በማሳወቅ፣ በጦርነት ውስጥ እንደማትሳተፍ አረጋግጠዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ የደቡብ ኮሪያን የሰላም እና ከጦርነት የመራቅ ፖሊሲ ያሳያል።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Kooriyaa Kibbaa Lee Jae Myung biyyi isaanii marii gama mootummaa Ameerikaa fi Kooriyaa Kaabaa gidduutti gaggeeffamu akka deebi'ee jalqabuuf hojjachaa akka jiran ibsaniiru. Kana malees, dhiibbaa taasifame osoo hin hordofin, Kooriyaan Kibbaa waraana qaxxaamura Hormuz keessatti hirmaachuuf loltoota akka hin ergine mirkaneessaniiru. Gochi kun biyyattii waraana biyya alaa keessa seenuu akka hin barbaadne kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Fire engulfs Zaporizhzhia shopping centre after Russian strike
english: A Russian military strike has caused a large fire at a shopping mall located in the Ukrainian city of Zaporizhzhia. Despite ongoing international efforts led by the United States to secure a temporary ceasefire, negotiations between the two nations are currently at a standstill. The incident highlights the continuing violence in the region as the conflict persists without a clear path toward resolution.
amharic: የሩሲያ ወታደሮች በዩክሬኗ ዛፖሪዝሂያ ከተማ በሚገኝ የገበያ ማዕከል ላይ ባደረሱት ጥቃት ከፍተኛ የእሳት ቃጠሎ ተቀስቅሷል። አሜሪካ በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት እንዲፈጠር ጥረት ብታደርግም፣ የሰላም ንግግሮቹ አሁንም ምንም አይነት መሻሻል አላሳዩም። በጦርነቱ ምክንያት በሲቪል መሠረተ ልማቶች ላይ የሚደርሰው ጉዳት እንደቀጠለ ነው።
oromo: Humni waraana Raashiyaa magaalaa Zaaporizhiiyaa, Yookireen keessatti iddoo daldalaa tokko irratti miidhaa qaqqabsiiseen ibidde guddaan ka'eera. Gamtaan biyyoolessotaa fi Ameerikaan waraana kana dhaabsisuuf yaalii taasisanillee, mariin nagaa biyyoota lamaan gidduutti godhamu guutummaatti dhaabbatee jira. Hanga ammaatti waraanni kun ittuma fufuun miidhaa qaqqabsiisuu isaa itti fufeera.

title: Palestinian prisoner gives birth in Israeli jail raising fears for pregnant detainees
english: A 35-year-old Palestinian woman named Dana Joudeh gave birth in an Israeli prison after being held for six months without trial. Human rights advocates and former detainees are raising alarm over the lack of proper prenatal care, nutrition, and medical attention provided to her and other pregnant prisoners. This incident has triggered widespread concern for the safety of two other pregnant women currently being held in similar conditions.
amharic: ዳና ጁዴህ የተባለች የ35 ዓመት ፍልስጤማዊት ሴት ያለ ክስ በስድስት ወራት እስር ላይ እያለች በእስራኤል እስር ቤት ልጅ ወለደች። የእስር ቤቱ አካባቢ ለነፍሰ ጡር ሴቶች ተገቢውን የህክምና፣ የተመጣጠነ ምግብ እና የወሊድ እንክብካቤ አለማቅረቡ ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞና ስጋት አስነስቷል። ይህ ክስተት በአሁኑ ወቅት በ እስራኤል እስር ቤቶች ውስጥ የሚገኙ ሌሎች ሁለት ነፍሰ ጡር ሴቶች ደህንነት ላይ ስጋትን ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Dubartiin Falasxiin kan waggaa 35 taate Daanaa Juudeh jedhamtu, ji'a jahanf qorannoo malee hidhaa Israa'el keessa ergu booda mana hidhichaa keessatti mucaa ishee deetteerti. Namoonni mirga namoomaaf falman fi hidhamtoonni durii, dubartoota ulfa ta'an kanaaf wal’aansa fayyaa, nyaata madaalawaa fi kunuunsa barbaachisu dhabamuun isaanii yaaddoo guddaa akka uume ibsaniiru. Mudannoon kun yeroo ammaa bakka wal fakkaatu keessatti kan hidhaman dubartoota ulfa biroo lamaan irratti sodaa guddaa uumeera.

title: Yemeni army claim to have killed 30 Houthi fighters in Taiz over past day
english: The Yemeni military reported that 30 Houthi rebels were killed and 60 others injured during heavy fighting in the Al-Waziyah district near Taiz. Government warplanes conducted airstrikes against Houthi vehicles and assembly points during the 24-hour operation. These details were provided by official military media sources following the recent escalation in the area.
amharic: የየመን መንግስት ሰራዊት በታይዝ ግዛት ውስጥ በሚገኘው አል-ዋዚያ ወረዳ ባደረገው ከፍተኛ ውጊያ 30 የሁቲ ታጣቂዎችን መግደሉን እና 60 ሌሎችን ማቁሰሉን አስታውቋል። የመንግስት አየር ኃይልም በዚሁ አካባቢ በሚገኙ የሁቲ ተሽከርካሪዎች እና ማዕከላት ላይ የአየር ድብደባ መፈጸሙን የጦር ሰራዊቱ መገናኛ ብዙሃን ገልጸዋል። ይህ ግጭት ባለፉት 24 ሰዓታት ውስጥ የተካሄደ መሆኑ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Raayyaan ittisa biyya Yaman naannoo Ta’iz, aanaa Al-Waziyaatti guyyaa tokko keessatti loltoota Huutii 30 ajjeesuu fi 60 madoo taasisuu isaa beeksiseera. Xiyyaarri waraana Yamanis konkolaataalee fi iddoo walga’ii loltoota Huutii irratti haleellaa raawwataniiru. Odeeffannoon kun maddeen miidiyaa waraanaa mootummaan erga dhiyaatee booda kan gadihiifameedha.

title: Pakistan says time has come to implement Mecca defence pact
english: Pakistan's Defense Minister has declared that it is time to activate a security pact with Saudi Arabia and Turkey amid escalating Houthi attacks on the kingdom. Khawaja Asif emphasized that Pakistan is firmly dedicated to safeguarding the holy cities of Mecca and Medina. He stated that the country views the protection of these sacred sites as a primary obligation, regardless of the specific terms of the agreement.
amharic: የፓኪስታን የመከላከያ ሚኒስትር በሳውዲ አረቢያ ላይ እየተካሄደ ያለውን የሁቲ ጥቃት ተከትሎ፣ ከሳውዲ አረቢያ እና ከቱርክ ጋር የተደረገውን የመከላከያ ስምምነት ተግባራዊ ለማድረግ ጊዜው አሁን ነው ብለዋል። ካዋጃ አሲፍ ፓኪስታን ቅዱስ ከተሞች የሆኑትን መካ እና መዲናን ለመከላከል ቁርጠኛ መሆኗን ገልጸዋል። ስምምነቱ ቢኖርም ባይኖርም እነዚህን ቅዱስ ስፍራዎች መጠበቅ የሀገሪቱ ግዴታ እንደሆነም አክለዋል።
oromo: Ministirri ittisa biyya Paakistaan haleellaa Houthii Sa'udii Arabiyaa irratti hammaataa dhufuu ilaalchisee, waliigaltee ittisaa kan Sa'udii fi Turkie waliin mallatteeffame hojii irra oolchuun akka barbaachisu ibsaniiru. Khawaja Asif, Paakistaan magaalonni qulqulluun Makkaa fi Madiinaa akka hin tuqamne ittisuuf kutannoo qabdi jedhaniiru. Waliigaltichis ta'e waliigaltee malee, bakkeewwan kana eeguun dirqama biyyattii akka ta'e dubbataniiru.

title: South Korea's Lee says army will not be deployed to get involved in Middle East conflict
english: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung has confirmed that his nation will not send soldiers to join the ongoing conflict in the Middle East. He emphasized that maintaining this neutral stance remains a firm government policy. However, officials are currently evaluating potential ways to help protect maritime shipping routes in the Strait of Hormuz to ensure energy security.
amharic: የደቡብ ኮሪያው ፕሬዝዳንት ሊ ጄ ማዩንግ አገራቸው በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ለሚካሄደው ጦርነት ወታደሮችን እንደማትልክ አረጋግጠዋል። ይህንን ገለልተኛ አቋም መጠበቅ የመንግስት ጽኑ አቋም እንደሆነም ገልጸዋል። ይሁን እንጂ መንግስት የአለም የኢነርጂ አቅርቦትን ለመጠበቅ ሲባል በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት የባህር ጉዞን ደህንነት ለማስጠበቅ የሚቻልባቸውን መንገዶች እያጠና ነው።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Kooriyaa Kibbaa Lii Jee Maayung biyyi isaanii waraana giddu galeessa bahaa keessatti hirmaachuuf waraana akka hin ergine mirkaneessaniiru. Dhaabbanni mootummaa kun waraana keessatti hirmaachuu dhabuu irratti akka cichu ibsaniiru. Ta’us, mootummaan dhiyeessii anniisaa addunyaa eeguuf jecha, karaa markiboonni ittiin darban kan Hormuz keessatti nageenya eeguuf akkaataa itti gargaaruu danda'an qorachaa jira.

title: Saudi embassy hails 'strength' of ties with US amid proposed F-35 sale
english: The Saudi embassy in the United States has welcomed a proposal to purchase 48 F-35 fighter jets, describing it as evidence of a deep and long-standing strategic defense partnership. This potential $24.3 billion deal, which faces opposition from Israel, would make Saudi Arabia the first Arab nation to acquire these advanced fifth-generation warplanes. Officials stated that this cooperation is vital for maintaining regional security and building on their collaborative defense efforts.
amharic: የሳዑዲ አረቢያ ኤምባሲ በአሜሪካ የታቀደውን 48 የኤፍ-35 ተዋጊ አውሮፕላኖች ግዢ በመደገፍ፣ ይህ የሁለቱ ሀገራት የረጅም ጊዜ የደህንነት ትብብር ማሳያ መሆኑን ገልጿል። በ እስራኤል ተቃውሞ የገጠመውና 24.3 ቢሊዮን ዶላር ሊፈጅ የሚችለው ይህ ስምምነት፣ ሳዑዲ አረቢያ እነዚህን ዘመናዊ የጦር አውሮፕላኖች የምታገኝ የመጀመሪያዋ የአረብ ሀገር ያደርጋታል። የሁለቱ ሀገራት የጠበቀ ወታደራዊ ግንኙነት ለቀጠናው ሰላምና መረጋጋት ትልቅ ሚና እንዳለው ተመላክቷል።
oromo: Embaasiin Sa'udii Arabaa kan Ameerikaa jiru, sagantaa xiyyaarota waraana F-35 afurtamii saddeet bituuf karoorfamee jiruun kan gammade yoo ta'u, kunis hariiroo tarsiimoo biyyoota lamaanii kan yeroo dheeraa kan agarsiisuudha jedheera. Waliigalteen kun kan Israa'el mormiirra jirtuu fi doolara biliyoona 24.3 kan baasu yoo ta'u, Sa'udiin xiyyaarota ammayyaa kana kan argattu biyya Arabaa jalqabaa taasisa. Hojiin waliinii kun tasgabbii naannichaa fi cimina ittisaa biyyoota lamaaniitiif murteessaa akka ta'e ibsameera.

title: Former Assad officer sentenced to 60 years in US for torture
english: A former Syrian military official, Samir Ousman Alsheikh, has been sentenced to 60 years in a US prison for his role in torturing detainees at Adra Prison between 2005 and 2008. During his trial, victims provided harrowing testimony detailing brutal abuse, including beatings and being suspended in painful positions while held in isolation. The judge condemned his actions as exceptionally cruel, emphasizing that he utilized his authority to inflict violence on political dissenters without fear of accountability.
amharic: የቀድሞ የሶሪያ ወታደራዊ ባለስልጣን የሆኑት ሳሚር ኦስማን አልሼይክ፣ በ2005 እና 2008 መካከል በአድራ እስር ቤት ለፈጸሙት ጭካኔ የተሞላበት ድርጊት በአሜሪካ ፍርድ ቤት የ60 ዓመት እስራት ተፈርዶባቸዋል። በችሎቱ ወቅት የቀድሞ እስረኞች ተጠርጣሪው በግለሰቦች ላይ ያደረሱትን ከባድ የአካል ጉዳት እና ኢሰብአዊ ድርጊት በዝርዝር አስረድተዋል። ዳኛው የባለስልጣኑን ድርጊት እጅግ ጭካኔ የተሞላበት እና ስልጣንን ያለ አግባብ በመጠቀም የፈጸሙት ወንጀል በማለት አውግዘውታል።
oromo: Hojjetaan mootummaa fi ajajaan waraanaa duraanii Siriyaa, Samir Ousman Alsheikh, gidduu bara 2005 hanga 2008tti mana hidhaa Adraa keessatti namoota irratti gidiraa fi dararaa cimaa raawwachuun isaa mirkanaa'ee waggaa 60 hidhuuf murtaa'eera. Murtii kana irratti ragaaleen dhiyaatan, shakkamaan kun namoota irratti reebicha hamaa fi dararaa qaamaa gara jabinaa qabu raawwachuu isaanii ibsaniiru. Abbaan murtii gocha isaa kana akka gocha hamaa fi aangoo isaa fayyadamee namoota irratti gidiraa cimaa geessiseetti ilaaluun murtii kana dabarsaniiru.

title: Tunisia floods disrupt capital as heavy rain traps motorists and residents
english: Heavy rainfall recently paralyzed Tunisia's capital, causing severe flooding that trapped commuters in their vehicles and triggered power and internet outages. Residents and local experts have expressed growing frustration, noting that the city's drainage systems frequently fail to handle seasonal rains. Despite advance weather warnings, critics argue that authorities have neglected essential infrastructure maintenance and flood prevention measures.

title: Iran expels Swedish diplomat in retaliatory move
english: Iran has ordered a Swedish diplomat to leave the country within two days in direct retaliation for Sweden’s decision to expel an Iranian official. Sweden justified its move by citing concerns over Iranian activities that threatened national security and specifically targeted Jewish and Israeli interests. In response, Iran condemned the Swedish action as unjustified, accusing Stockholm of being influenced by foreign pressure and failing to uphold diplomatic standards.

title: Iran war live: Trump weighs ‘big decision’ on Iran, tanker hit in Hormuz
english: President Donald Trump is considering a significant military decision regarding Iran, noting that any outcome is possible as tensions rise. Meanwhile, Iran's Revolutionary Guard reported attacking a cargo ship in the Strait of Hormuz, claiming the vessel was operating illegally. These events highlight a growing instability in the region as both nations remain at a critical standoff.

title: Migrant sea crossings to Europe drop sharply as deaths rise: IOM
english: The International Organization for Migration reports that the number of migrants attempting to reach Europe by sea has fallen significantly this year. However, despite fewer people making the journey, the number of deaths and disappearances has increased, making these maritime routes deadlier than before. Officials emphasize that most migrants are fleeing war, persecution, and economic hardship, and they are calling for stronger international action to provide safer migration pathways.

title: US approves $414M uranium investment in Niger, two years after troops left
english: The United States government has authorized $414 million in financing for a major uranium mining project in Niger operated by the Canadian firm Global Atomic. This significant investment aims to secure American access to critical mineral supplies while strengthening diplomatic ties following the withdrawal of U.S. troops from the region. Despite ongoing political instability and security concerns in Niger, the project is viewed as a strategic move to counter the influence of rival global powers in the energy sector.

title: Russia election: Could other parties challenge United Russia?
english: Russia is holding its first elections since the onset of the conflict in Ukraine in 2022. The governing party, United Russia, has maintained its hold on power for more than twenty years with the support of President Vladimir Putin. Voters are now considering whether any of the opposing political parties can effectively contest the ruling party's long-standing dominance.

title: Trinidad and Tobago ends state of emergency amid pushback over mass arrests
english: Trinidad and Tobago has officially ended its state of emergency, which previously allowed authorities to detain citizens without filing formal charges. This decision follows significant public and legal backlash regarding mass arrests and alleged human rights violations during the crackdown on crime. Moving forward, the government intends to develop permanent legislation focused on fighting gangs and violent crime while incorporating better judicial oversight.

title: US judge orders 30-day notice prior to any Kennedy Center physical changes
english: A federal judge has mandated that the Kennedy Center must provide a 30-day notice before undertaking any significant structural modifications or demolition. This ruling follows concerns regarding the facility's safety and President Trump's recent comments suggesting the building might need to be torn down. The center is currently closed for repairs due to identified structural risks, sparking a legal disagreement over its future.

oromo: Abbaan seeraa federaalaa kan Amerikaa, giddugalli Kennedy Center jijjiirama gurguddaa ykn diiggaa kamiyyuu gaggeessuu isaa dura guyyaa 30 dursanii beeksisuu akka qaban ajajaniiru. Ajajni kun kan dhufe erga giddugalli kun rakkoo nageenyaatiin sababeeffatee cufamee fi Prezidaantiin Donald Trump giddugalli kun diigamuu danda'a jechuun erga dubbatanii booda. Amma giddugalli kun rakkoo qulqullina ijaarsaa irraa kan ka'e haaromsaaf cufamee kan jiru yoo ta'u, kunis mata duree wal-dhabdee seeraa ta'ee jira.

title: Trump administration approves sale of F-35 jets to Saudi Arabia
english: The Trump administration has requested congressional approval for a $24.3 billion deal to sell 48 advanced F-35 fighter jets to Saudi Arabia. Officials state this sale aims to strengthen a key regional ally without disrupting the existing military balance, even as Saudi forces face increased pressure from Houthi fighters in Yemen. However, the proposal faces scrutiny due to concerns regarding potential Chinese intelligence access to the technology and the ongoing intensity of the Yemeni conflict.
amharic: የዶናልድ ትራምፕ አስተዳደር 48 ዘመናዊ የኤፍ-35 ተዋጊ ጄቶችን ለሳዑዲ ዓረቢያ በ24.3 ቢሊዮን ዶላር ለመሸጥ ከኮንግረስ ፈቃድ ጠይቋል። መንግሥት ይህ ስምምነት የቀጠናውን ወታደራዊ ሚዛን ሳይቀይር ጠቃሚ አጋርን ለማጠናከር ያለመ መሆኑን ገልጿል። ይሁን እንጂ ስምምነቱ በየመን ግጭት መባባስ እና የቻይና የስለላ ድርጅቶች ይህንን የጦር ቴክኖሎጂ የመቆጣጠር አቅም ይኖራቸዋል በሚል ስጋት የበርካታ ወገኖችን ትችት አስነስቷል።
oromo: Mootummaan Donald Trump xiyyaarota waraanaa gosa F-35 ta'an 48 biyya Saudi Arabiaaf doolaara biliyoona 24.3n gurguruuf hayyama Kongiresii gaafateera. Mootummaan US akka jedhutti, gurgurtaan kun walmadaallii waraanaa naannichaa osoo hin jijjiirin michummaa biyyoota lamaan cimsuuf kan gargaaru dha. Ta'us, gurgurtaan kun waraana Yemen keessatti hammaataa jiruun akkasumas soda teknolojii waraanaa kana irratti humni Chaayinaa harka galfachuu danda'a jedhuun mormii fi yaaddoo keessa seeneera.

title: US to allow Iran delegation to attend UN meetings in New York as war passes half-year mark
english: The United States has issued visas to a group of Iranian officials, including President Masoud Pezeshkian, to attend the upcoming UN General Assembly in New York. While these officials are permitted to participate in the diplomatic meetings, the US government has imposed strict travel and purchasing limitations on the delegation. These restrictions aim to prevent the group from engaging in luxury shopping while emphasizing that the move is necessary to fulfill international host obligations.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት የኢራኑን ፕሬዝዳንት መስዑድ መድሃኒያንን ጨምሮ ለኢራን ልዑካን በኒውዮርክ በሚካሄደው የተባበሩት መንግስታት ጠቅላላ ጉባኤ ላይ እንዲሳተፉ ቪዛ ሰጥቷል። ልዑካኑ በዲፕሎማሲያዊ ስብሰባዎች ላይ እንዲሳተፉ ቢፈቀድላቸውም፣ አሜሪካ በጉዞአቸው እና በግዢያቸው ላይ ጥብቅ ገደቦችን ጥላለች። እነዚህ ገደቦች ልዑካኑ የቅንጦት ዕቃዎችን እንዳይገዙ ለመከላከል ያለመ ሲሆን፣ ውሳኔውም የተባበሩት መንግስታትን የመስተንግዶ ግዴታዎች ለመወጣት ታሳቢ ተደርጎ የተወሰደ ነው።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa pirezidaantii Iraan Masuud Pezeshkian dabalatee garee bakka buutota Iraanif sagantaa walga'ii waliigalaa Tokkummaa Mootummootaa Nyuuyorkitti gaggeeffamu irratti hirmaachuuf hayyama seeninsaa (visa) kenneera. Bakka buutonni kun walga'iiwwan diippiloomaasii irratti akka hirmaatan kan hayyamameef ta'us, Ameerikaan imala fi bituu meeshaalee irratti daangaa cimaa keesseerti. Daangaan kun gareen kun meeshaalee gita ol aanaa akka hin bitne kan taasisu yoo ta'u, murtoon kunis dirqama biyya hostii ta'uun ishee bahuuf kan fudhatame dha.

title: Yemenis recount journey to Djibouti as refugee arrivals surge
english: A growing number of refugees are fleeing the ongoing conflict in Yemen and arriving in Djibouti seeking safety. In response to this surge, the Djiboutian government has requested urgent international aid to support these displaced individuals. Local authorities are struggling to manage the influx and are calling for global assistance to provide necessary humanitarian relief.
amharic: በየመን እየተካሄደ ካለው ግጭት በመሸሽ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ስደተኞች ወደ ጅቡቲ እየገቡ ይገኛሉ። የጅቡቲ መንግስት ለስደተኞቹ ሰብአዊ ድጋፍ ለማድረግ ከአለም አቀፉ ማህበረሰብ እርዳታ ጠይቋል። አገሪቱ ከስደተኞች መጨመር ጋር ተያይዞ የሚያጋጥማትን ጫና ለመቋቋም የአለም አቀፍ ድጋፍ እንደሚያስፈልጋት አስታውቃለች።
oromo: Namoonni kumaan lakkaa'aman waraana Yemen keessatti geggeeffamaa jiru irraa baqachuun nagaa barbaacha gara Jibuutii imalaa jiru. Mootummaan Jibuutiis baqattoota kana gargaaruuf gargaarsa idil-addunyaa gaafateera. Baqattoonni kun baay'achaa waan jiraniif, biyyattiin rakkoo kana ba'uuf deeggarsa hatattamaa barbaaddi.

title: US approves visas for top Iranian leaders to attend UN General Assembly
english: The United States has granted visas to key Iranian officials, including President Masoud Pezeshkian, to attend the upcoming UN General Assembly in New York. While the delegation is permitted to enter the country, they will face significant travel restrictions and limits on luxury purchases. This decision comes amidst ongoing military tensions between the two nations, even as other officials, such as those from the Palestinian Authority, have been denied entry.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት የኢራኑን ፕሬዝዳንት መስዑድ ፔዘሽኪያን ጨምሮ ለተወሰኑ ከፍተኛ የኢራን ባለስልጣናት በኒውዮርክ በሚካሄደው የተባበሩት መንግስታት ጠቅላላ ጉባኤ ላይ እንዲገኙ ቪዛ ፈቅዷል። ልዑኩ ወደ አሜሪካ እንዲገቡ ቢፈቀድላቸውም፣ ጥብቅ የጉዞ ገደቦች እና የቅንጦት ዕቃዎችን ከመግዛት ጋር የተያያዙ ክልከላዎች ተጥለውባቸዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለው ወታደራዊ ውጥረት ባለበት ወቅት የተወሰደ ሲሆን፣ እንደ ፍልስጤም ባለስልጣናት ላሉ ሌሎች አካላት ግን ቪዛ መከልከሉ ይታወቃል።
oromo: Mootummaan Amerikaa pirezidaantii Iraan Masuud Pezeeshkiyaanii dabalatee qondaaltonni olaanoo biyyattii gamaagama walii galaa dhaabbata mootummoota gamtoomanii Niiwuu Yoorkitti gaggeeffamu irratti akka hirmaatan hayyama viizaa kenneera. Gareen kun biyyattii akka seenan hayyamameefis, daangaa imalaafi bitii meeshaalee jaalalaa irratti uggurri cimaan irratti taa'eera. Murtichi biyyoota lamaan gidduutti walitti bu'iinsi waraanaa utuu jiru kan fudhatame yoo ta'u, qondaaltonni biroo kanneen akka bulchiinsa Falasxiinii garuu viizaa akka hin arganne taasifameera.

title: Pennsylvania seeks CDC help amid dispute over US measles deaths
english: Pennsylvania is requesting federal assistance from the CDC to manage a worsening measles outbreak, which is the most severe in the U.S. since 1991. However, state officials are threatening to cancel this help unless the CDC officially acknowledges four deaths the state attributes to the virus. Federal health officials have criticized this stance, arguing that public health aid should not be used as a tool for political leverage.
amharic: ፔንስልቬንያ በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ እየተስፋፋ ያለውን የኩፍኝ ወረርሽኝ ለመቆጣጠር ከበሽታ መቆጣጠሪያ ማዕከል (CDC) እርዳታ ጠይቃለች። ሆኖም የክልሉ ባለስልጣናት በቫይረሱ ምክንያት የሞቱ አራት ሰዎችን የሟቾች ዝርዝር ውስጥ ካልካተቱ የጠየቁትን እርዳታ እንደሚሰርዙ አስፈራርተዋል። የፌደራል ጤና ጥበቃ ባለስልጣናት ይህን ድርጊት የህዝብ ጤና እርዳታን ለፖለቲካ መጠቀሚያ ለማድረግ መሞከር ነው በማለት ነቅፈውታል።
oromo: Pensilveeniyaan tatamsa'ina dhukkuba mannxaa to'achuuf gargaarsa CDC gaafatteetti, kunis walitti fufiinsa dhukkuba mannxaa bara 1991 as biyyattii keessatti mudate keessaa isa hamaadha. Haata'u malee, qondaaltonni naannichaa yoo CDC namoota dhukkubichaan du'an afur raasmiin beekamtii hin kennine gargaarsa gaafatame akka haqan doorsisaniiru. Qondaaltonni fayyaa federaalaa gochi kun gargaarsa fayyaa ummataa akka meeshaa siyaasaatti fayyadamuu akka ta'e ibsuun balaaleffataniiru.

title: Russia, China veto UN mandate to monitor Iran sanctions
english: Russia and China have blocked a United Nations Security Council resolution that sought to extend the mandate for an independent panel to monitor sanctions against Iran. This move effectively eliminates the watchdog group responsible for investigating and reporting potential violations of nuclear and military restrictions. While eleven nations supported the extension, the opposition from the two permanent members leaves a significant gap in international oversight of Iran's activities.
amharic: ሩሲያ እና ቻይና በአሜሪካ ድጋፍ የቀረበውን እና በኢራን ላይ የተጣሉ ማዕቀቦችን በገለልተኛ አካል እንዲከታተሉ የሚያስችለውን የተባበሩት መንግስታት የጸጥታው ምክር ቤት ውሳኔ ውድቅ አድርገዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ የኢራንን የኒውክሌር እና ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴዎች በመከታተል የህግ ጥሰቶችን የሚዘግብበትን ሂደት እንዲያበቃ አድርጓል። ምንም እንኳን አብዛኛዎቹ የካውንስሉ አባላት የክትትል ስራው እንዲቀጥል ቢደግፉም፣ የሁለቱ ሀገራት ተቃውሞ በአለም አቀፍ ደረጃ የሚደረገውን የክትትል ስራ አቋርጦታል።
oromo: Raashiyaan fi Chaayinaan murtoo Mana Maree Nageenyaa Dhaabbata Mootummoota Gamtoomanii kan irratti adabbiiwwan biyyoolessa Iraan irratti kaa'aman gamtaa walabaan hordofuu dandeessisu mormuun akka hin raggaane taasisaniiru. Murteen kun garee qorattootaa kan seera cabsuu Iraan irratti gabaasa dhiheessaa ture akka dhaabbatu godheera. Biyyoonni 11 murtoo kana deggeran iyyuu, mormiin biyyoota lamaanii kun hordoffii addunyaa irratti Iraan gochaa jirtu irratti taasifamu akka gufatu taasisera.

title: At least 26 killed in clashes along Sudan-South Sudan border region
english: Violent clashes between the Ngok Dinka and Misseriya communities in the disputed Abyei region have resulted in at least 26 deaths and 82 injuries. The fighting was triggered by separate killings earlier in the week at a local market, worsening long-standing tensions over land and resources. The UN peacekeeping force in the area has increased security measures and is currently working with community leaders to restore peace and prevent further violence.
amharic: በሱዳን እና በደቡብ ሱዳን ድንበር ላይ በሚገኘው አቢዬ ክልል በንግኦክ ዲንካ እና በሚሴሪያ ማህበረሰቦች መካከል በተፈጠረ ግጭት ቢያንስ 26 ሰዎች ሲሞቱ 82 የሚሆኑት ደግሞ ቆስለዋል። ግጭቱ የተቀሰቀሰው በአካባቢው ገበያ ላይ በተፈጸሙ የግለሰብ ግድያዎች ምክንያት ሲሆን፣ ይህንም ተከትሎ በሁለቱ ቡድኖች መካከል የነበረው የረጅም ጊዜ አለመግባባት ተባብሷል። የተባበሩት መንግስታት የሰላም አስከባሪ ኃይል በአካባቢው ያለውን የፀጥታ ሁኔታ በማጠናከር ግጭቱን ለማብረድ ከማህበረሰብ መሪዎች ጋር እየሰራ ይገኛል።
oromo: Naannoo Abyei kan daangaa Sudaan fi Sudaan Kibbaa gidduutti argamuutti walitti bu'iinsa uumamee tureen namoonni 26 ol ajjeefamanii 82 immoo madaa'aniiru. Walitti bu'iinsi kun kan ka'e gabaa naannichaa keessatti namoota ajjeefamanii booda yoo ta'u, kunis waldhabdee lafaa fi qabeenya irratti gosa lamaan gidduutti ture hammeesseera. Humnoonni nageenya kabachiiftotaa UN naannichatti ramadaman nageenya eeguuf tarkaanfii jabeessanii fi walitti bu'iinsi biroo akka hin uumamneef hoggantoota gosaa wajjin mari'achaa jiru.
